> **Draft for review, not intended to merge as is.** This PR is one of a bundle of model ports, each passing its verification gates on its own. Some of them change shared code (checkpoint conversion hooks, patches, model bases) in overlapping ways. A second code-reuse round will consolidate that shared code across the bundle and resubmit as a sequence of smaller PRs: shared infrastructure first, then each model on top. Review comments on correctness are most useful now; comments on structure and reuse will feed that round.

## Summary

Adds `allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B` (revision `a81bae42db39`) to Primus. Primer, an agent that onboards models to Primus, generated this change from run `Olmo-3-1025-7B-20261031-045501-6228` and verified it on `main` at `0f996490ad1b`. It is a draft for maintainer review.

+| `keep_absolute_save_path` | `false` (the OLMo-3 examples set `true`) | *Primus patch* `megatron.args.checkpoint_path`: on keeps an absolute `save` as given (a later `load` there resumes); a relative or `~/` `save` is refused. A switch value (1/0, yes/no, on/off); unset is `false`; another value is refused, also with `save: null`. |
 | `save_interval` | `20000` (`1000` in `pre_trainer.yaml`) | Save every N iterations. |
 | `save_retain_interval` | `null` | Retain checkpoints at this interval. |
 | `no_save_optim` | `null` | Skip optimizer state in checkpoints when truthy. |
@@ -419,6 +420,7 @@ models:
 | `one_logger_project` | `megatron-lm` | OneLogger project string. |
 | `one_logger_run_name` | `null` | OneLogger run name. |
 | `log_interval` | `100` (`1` in `pre_trainer.yaml`) | Console log interval in iterations. |
+| `log_reset_first_iteration` | `false` (the OLMo-3 examples set `true`) | *Primus patch* `megatron.training_log.first_iteration_reset`, the same for every model: when the first iteration of a run (fresh or resumed) is on the log schedule, upstream `training_log` gets it as a regular logged iteration, so upstream resets the loss sums, counters and timers after it. Without it, the second logged loss of a run with `log_interval: 1` is the mean of two iterations. The reset applies to every value derived from the interval: after the first logged iteration, the stdout and TensorBoard / WandB `throughput`, `iter-energy/gpu` and `power/gpu` cover that interval only, not the start-up. The first `iteration-time`, which includes start-up, is still not written to TensorBoard / WandB. A first iteration off the log schedule (a resume at an iteration that is not a multiple of `log_interval`) is logged as upstream does. The patch refuses to install when upstream `training_log` reads `is_first_iteration` in other places than the Megatron version it is written for. Loss curves of runs with and without the switch differ at the second logged value. `true` / `false` (also 1/0, yes/no, on/off); unset (`null`, an empty string, or the strings `"null"` / `"~"`) is `false`; another value is refused at patch time. |

 | `decoder_num_layers` | `null` | Decoder depth. |
@@ -608,6 +610,28 @@ models:
 | `attn_logit_softcapping` | `null` | Softcap for attention logits. |
 | `router_logit_softcapping` | `null` | Softcap for MoE router logits. |
 
+### 10.8 OLMo-3 (`model_type: olmo3`, preset `olmo_3_1025_7B.yaml`)
+
+The `olmo3_*` keys below are read only by the Primus-owned OLMo-3 model. The table also lists the
+upstream keys `window_size` and `window_attn_skip_freq`, which every GPT model reads; only the OLMo-3
+rules for them are described here. The HF form `[W, 0]` of `window_size` is converted only by the
+OLMo-3 args patch: for another model, `window_size` is always the Megatron / TE form `(W - 1, 0)`.
+For OLMo-3, the preset states the window once, as `window_size: [W, 0]` with `olmo3_window_size_form: hf`;
+override `window_size: [W, 0]` to change it.
+
+| Parameter | Default | Description |
+|-----------|---------|-------------|
+| `window_size` | `null` (upstream) | Upstream Megatron key (every GPT model): the sliding-window size; `null` means full attention. In Megatron / TE form it is `(W - 1, 0)`. The OLMo-3 preset sets it in HF form `[4096, 0]` (`[W, 0]`, W = HF `sliding_window`) with `olmo3_window_size_form: hf`, and no `olmo3_sliding_window`; before the model is built the OLMo-3 args patch converts it once to `(W - 1, 0)` and sets `olmo3_sliding_window: W`. To change the OLMo-3 window, override `window_size: [W, 0]`. |
+| `window_attn_skip_freq` | `null` (upstream) | Upstream Megatron key: which layers skip the window (run full attention). An int N makes every N-th layer (1-based) full; a list gives one entry per layer (1 = sliding window, 0 = full). Upstream, `null` puts the window on every layer. For OLMo-3 the args patch accepts only an int k with 2 <= k <= `num_layers`, or a list of `num_layers` entries that holds at least one 0 and at least one 1 (the list may be written as an expression such as `[1,1,1,0]*8`); `null`, 1, and an all-sliding or all-full list are refused, because OLMo-3 mixes sliding and full layers. The OLMo-3 preset sets `4` (HF `layer_types`: 3 sliding, then 1 full). |
+| `olmo3_yarn_rotary_scaling_factor` | `1.0` | YaRN factor (HF `rope_scaling.factor`; `8.0` in the 7B preset). `1.0` means no YaRN. |
+| `olmo3_yarn_original_max_position_embeddings` | `null` | YaRN original context (HF `original_max_position_embeddings`; `8192` in the preset). Required when the factor is > 1. |
+| `olmo3_yarn_beta_fast` | `32.0` | YaRN `beta_fast`. |
+| `olmo3_yarn_beta_slow` | `1.0` | YaRN `beta_slow`. |
+| `olmo3_yarn_attention_factor` | `null` | YaRN attention factor m (the logits are scaled by m²). `null` uses `0.1 * ln(factor) + 1`. The 7B preset leaves it unset (`0.1 * ln(8) + 1` = `1.2079441541679836`, the HF config's value), so an override of `olmo3_yarn_rotary_scaling_factor` moves it too; an explicit value that differs from the derived one is used and logged as a warning. Must be > 0; the factor must be >= 1. |

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HF q / k / v -> mcore linear_qkv
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def fuse_qkv(q, k, v, nh: int, ng: int, hdim: int, hidden: int):
+    """HF q / k / v projections -> mcore ``linear_qkv``: per query group, its ``nh / ng`` query
+    heads, then its key head, then its value head (no RoPE permutation). Used by the Qwen3,
+    Llama and OLMo-3 converters (one copy of the layout)."""
+    if ng <= 0 or nh <= 0 or nh % ng:
+        raise ValueError(f"num_heads ({nh}) must be a positive multiple of num_query_groups ({ng})")
+    for name, w, rows in (("q", q, nh * hdim), ("k", k, ng * hdim), ("v", v, ng * hdim)):
+        if tuple(w.shape) != (rows, hidden):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"HF {name}_proj weight has shape {tuple(w.shape)}, expected ({rows}, {hidden}) for "
+                f"num_heads={nh}, num_query_groups={ng}, head_dim={hdim}, hidden={hidden} (a transposed "
+                "or mismatched checkpoint)"
+            )
+    return torch.cat(
+        [
+            q.reshape(ng, (nh // ng) * hdim, hidden),
+            k.reshape(ng, hdim, hidden),
+            v.reshape(ng, hdim, hidden),
+        ],
+        dim=1,
+    ).reshape(-1, hidden)

+"""OLMo-3 policy of the SFT conversion hook (``01_convert_checkpoints.py``).
+
+The shared hook detects the family and calls :func:`run_native_flow` for OLMo-3; the other
+families keep the hook's own flow. This module holds what is OLMo-3 specific:
+
+* the training-layout check (the converter writes TP = PP = EP = 1 only);
+* the converter options taken from the training config;
+* the conversion record ``primus_native_convert.json`` that a reused checkpoint must match;
+* the rank-0-converts / others-wait flow with fail-fast for the waiting nodes;
+* an OLMo-3 source given as a hub id: rank 0 gets a complete snapshot, the other nodes wait for it.
+
+No Megatron import at module level (the hook process imports this before Megatron is on the path).
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import socket
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from primus.core.utils.arg_utils import as_int, is_unset
+
+WAIT_TIMEOUT = 3600  # seconds; native_ckpt_wait_timeout overrides it
+CONVERT_RECORD = "primus_native_convert.json"
+TRACKER_FILE = "latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt"  # Megatron's marker of a complete checkpoint
+# Bump when the converter changes the saved weights or args, so old checkpoints are not reused.
+CONVERTER_VERSION = 1
+# Record keys kept for information only: not compared when a checkpoint is reused. Every node
+# computes the record from its own view of the source, and the realpath of hf_path differs between
+# nodes that mount the HF directory at another path (symlinks, a node-local cache); the config
+# sha256 and the weights fingerprint already identify the source.
+_INFO_ONLY_KEYS = ("hf_path",)
+_WEIGHT_GLOBS = ("*.safetensors", "*.bin", "*.safetensors.index.json", "*.bin.index.json")
+
+
+def config_int(opts: dict, key: str, default: int | None = None) -> int | None:
+    """``opts[key]`` as an int (the shared ``as_int``: YAML / CLI values may be strings), else a
+    clear ValueError. Unset values (the shared ``is_unset``: None, "", null / ~) give
+    ``default``."""
+    value = opts.get(key)
+    if is_unset(value):
+        return default
+    return as_int(value, key)
+
+
+def check_single_shard_layout(tp, pp, ep) -> None:
+    """Refuse a layout other than TP = PP = EP = 1: the OLMo-3 converter runs in a 1-rank world
+    and writes a single-shard checkpoint, which is not resharded at load."""
+    if tuple(int(x) for x in (tp, pp, ep)) != (1, 1, 1):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "the OLMo-3 converter writes single-shard TP=PP=EP=1 checkpoints (it runs in a 1-rank "
+            f"world); got TP={tp} PP={pp} EP={ep}"
+        )
+
+
+def single_shard_conflict(opts: dict) -> str | None:
+    """The error message when the run trains with TP, PP or EP > 1, else None."""
+    tp = config_int(opts, "tensor_model_parallel_size", 1)
+    pp = config_int(opts, "pipeline_model_parallel_size", 1)
+    ep = config_int(opts, "expert_model_parallel_size", 1)
+    try:
+        check_single_shard_layout(tp, pp, ep)
+        return None
+    except ValueError as e:
+        return (
+            f"Native OLMo-3 conversion: {e}, but this run trains with "
+            f"tensor_model_parallel_size={tp}, pipeline_model_parallel_size={pp}, "
+            f"expert_model_parallel_size={ep}; a legacy torch checkpoint is not resharded at load. "
+            "Convert once with TP=PP=EP=1 and set pretrained_checkpoint to a checkpoint in the training "
+            "layout. The torch -> torch_dist reshard step in docs/04-technical-guides/native-sft-lora.md "
+            "is UNVERIFIED (experimental) for OLMo-3."
+        )
+
+
+def converter_options(opts: dict) -> dict:
+    """Training-config settings the OLMo-3 converter takes.
+
+    * ``make_vocab_size_divisible_by`` sets the padded vocab rows of the embedding and output
+      weights, so it is always passed (Megatron's default 128 when the config does not set it).
+    * ``rope_layout`` (``olmo3_rope_layout``): stored in the checkpoint args. ``auto`` is refused
+      here (:func:`requested_rope_layout`); convert() refuses a layout that disagrees with the HF
+      config.
+    """
+    extra = {"make_vocab_size_divisible_by": config_int(opts, "make_vocab_size_divisible_by", 128)}
+    layout = requested_rope_layout(opts)
+    if layout is not None:
+        extra["rope_layout"] = layout
+    return extra
+
+
+def requested_rope_layout(opts: dict) -> str | None:
+    """``olmo3_rope_layout`` for a conversion, normalised once (spaces stripped, lower case), so the
+    converter and the conversion record get the same value: ``per_type``, ``yarn_all`` or None
+    (unset). ``auto`` and other values raise here, at option parsing, before any lock is taken."""
+    raw = opts.get("olmo3_rope_layout")
+    if is_unset(raw):
+        return None
+    layout = str(raw).strip().lower()
+    if layout == "auto":
+        raise ValueError("olmo3_rope_layout must be per_type or yarn_all for a conversion, not auto")
+    if layout not in ("per_type", "yarn_all"):
+        raise ValueError(f"olmo3_rope_layout must be per_type or yarn_all, got {raw!r}")
+    return layout
+
+
+_SAMPLE_BLOCKS, _SAMPLE_BYTES = 16, 64 * 1024
+
+
+def _sampled_digest(path: Path, size: int) -> bytes:
+    """sha256 of ``_SAMPLE_BLOCKS`` blocks of ``_SAMPLE_BYTES`` spread evenly over the file (the
+    first and the last included; the whole file when it is smaller), so ~1 MiB is read per file."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
+        if size <= _SAMPLE_BLOCKS * _SAMPLE_BYTES:
+            digest.update(fh.read())
+        else:
+            step = (size - _SAMPLE_BYTES) // (_SAMPLE_BLOCKS - 1)
+            for k in range(_SAMPLE_BLOCKS):
+                fh.seek(k * step)
+                digest.update(fh.read(_SAMPLE_BYTES))
+    return digest.digest()
+
+
+def weights_fingerprint(hf_path: str) -> str:
+    """sha256 over the weight files of ``hf_path``: per file its name, its size and its content
+    (index files: all of it; weight files: 16 blocks of 64 KiB spread over the file, see
+    :func:`_sampled_digest`, so a 7B model costs ~1 MiB of reads per shard, not ~15 GB).
+
+    Two checkpoints of one architecture (base vs. instruct, two training snapshots) have the same
+    index files and shard sizes but other bytes in every block, so they differ here. Limit: two
+    weight sets that differ only outside the sampled blocks are not told apart."""
+    root = Path(hf_path)
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    files = sorted({p for g in _WEIGHT_GLOBS for p in root.glob(g) if p.is_file()})
+    for p in files:
+        size = p.stat().st_size
+        digest.update(p.name.encode() + b"\0" + str(size).encode() + b"\0")
+        if p.name.endswith(".index.json"):
+            digest.update(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest())
+        else:
+            digest.update(_sampled_digest(p, size))
+        digest.update(b"\0")
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _record_rope_layout(hf_path: str, opts: dict) -> str:
+    """The concrete ``olmo3_rope_layout`` convert() saves, as convert() resolves it (the config's
+    per-layer-type layout, else the requested layout, else ``per_type``); ``auto`` is refused as in
+    convert(). No Megatron import."""
+    from primus.backends.megatron.checkpoint import native_loader_olmo3 as conv
+
+    requested = requested_rope_layout(opts)
+    cfg = conv.common.read_hf_config(hf_path)
+    full, cfg_layout, _ = conv._rope_config(cfg)
+    if cfg_layout is not None:
+        if requested is not None and requested != cfg_layout:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 config declares olmo3_rope_layout {cfg_layout!r}, but {requested!r} was requested"
+            )
+        return cfg_layout
+    if requested == "yarn_all":
+        yarn = conv._yarn_params(full, cfg)
+        if yarn is None or yarn["factor"] <= 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("olmo3_rope_layout 'yarn_all' needs YaRN rope parameters (factor > 1)")
+    return requested or "per_type"
+
+
+def convert_record(hf_path: str, opts: dict, dtype: str) -> dict:
+    """The OLMo-3 conversion settings and source identity of a checkpoint."""
+    cfg = Path(hf_path) / "config.json"
+    return {
+        "family": "olmo3",
+        "converter_version": CONVERTER_VERSION,
+        "hf_path": os.path.realpath(hf_path),
+        "hf_config_sha256": hashlib.sha256(cfg.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if cfg.is_file() else None,
+        "hf_weights_fingerprint": weights_fingerprint(hf_path),
+        "dtype": dtype,
+        "make_vocab_size_divisible_by": converter_options(opts)["make_vocab_size_divisible_by"],
+        "olmo3_rope_layout": _record_rope_layout(hf_path, opts),
+    }
+
+
+def stale_checkpoint_reason(megatron_path: Path, want: dict) -> str | None:
+    """Why the OLMo-3 checkpoint at ``megatron_path`` cannot be reused for ``want``, else None."""
+    record = Path(megatron_path) / CONVERT_RECORD
+    if not record.is_file():
+        return f"it has no {CONVERT_RECORD} (its conversion settings are unknown)"
+    try:
+        have = json.loads(record.read_text())
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
+        return f"its {CONVERT_RECORD} is unreadable ({e})"
+    diff = {k: (have.get(k), v) for k, v in want.items() if k not in _INFO_ONLY_KEYS and have.get(k) != v}
+    if not diff:
+        return None
+    return "it was converted with other settings: " + ", ".join(
+        f"{k}: {a!r} (checkpoint) vs {b!r} (this run)" for k, (a, b) in sorted(diff.items())
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# failure marker: rank 0 writes <out>.failed when it stops, so the other nodes stop too
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+LAUNCH_ID_KEYS = (
+    "PRIMUS_LAUNCH_ID",
+    "SLURM_JOB_ID",
+    "SLURM_STEP_ID",
+    "SLURM_RESTART_COUNT",
+    "TORCHELASTIC_RUN_ID",
+    "MASTER_ADDR",
+    "MASTER_PORT",
+)
+
+
+def _launch_id() -> str | None:
+    """An id that all nodes of one launch share, joined from every variable that is set (in the
+    order of ``LAUNCH_ID_KEYS``; no source wins over another), else None.
+
+    ``PRIMUS_LAUNCH_ID`` (set by the caller), ``SLURM_JOB_ID`` with ``SLURM_STEP_ID`` and
+    ``SLURM_RESTART_COUNT`` (another srun step or a requeue is another launch),
+    ``TORCHELASTIC_RUN_ID`` and ``MASTER_ADDR:MASTER_PORT``. A later launch can have the same id
+    (the same address and port outside a scheduler, a retry in one allocation), so a marker also
+    has to be newer than the node's wait or survive rank 0's first step (:class:`FailureWatch`)."""
+    parts = [f"{k}={os.environ[k]}" for k in LAUNCH_ID_KEYS if os.environ.get(k)]
+    return ";".join(parts) if parts else None
+
+
+def failed_marker(megatron_path) -> Path:
+    return Path(f"{megatron_path}.failed")
+
+
+def write_failure(megatron_path, reason: str) -> None:
+    """Rank 0: record why it stopped (best effort; a failed write leaves the timeout)."""
+    try:
+        Path(megatron_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        failed_marker(megatron_path).write_text(
+            json.dumps({"reason": reason, "launch": _launch_id(), "time": time.time()}) + "\n"
+        )
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+
+
+def _storage_now(megatron_path, node_rank: int) -> float | None:
+    """The current time of the storage that holds ``<out>.failed`` (the mtime of a file this node
+    touches next to it), so it compares with the marker's mtime without clock skew between nodes.
+    None if the file cannot be written."""
+    stamp = Path(f"{megatron_path}.waiting.node{node_rank}")
+    try:
+        stamp.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        stamp.touch()
+        return stamp.stat().st_mtime
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    finally:
+        try:
+            stamp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+
+
+# A marker written before a waiting node took ``since`` (or in the same mtime second) is not known
+# to be this launch's: it can be a stale marker of an earlier launch (also one with the same launch
+# id, e.g. a retry inside one SLURM allocation or a constant PRIMUS_LAUNCH_ID). Rank 0 removes any
+# marker as its first step (:func:`clear_failure`), so such a marker that is still in place,
+# unchanged, this many seconds after the waiting node first saw it is rank 0's (rank 0 stopped
+# early): the waiting node stops. The grace covers a rank 0 that starts later than the other nodes.
+MARKER_GRACE = 600
+
+
+def clear_failure(megatron_path) -> None:
+    """Rank 0, first step: remove ``<out>.failed`` (of an earlier launch)."""
+    try:
+        failed_marker(megatron_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+
+
+def _marker(megatron_path):
+    """``(reason, mtime, launch)`` of ``<out>.failed`` when it is readable and is not of another
+    launch (the launch ids differ when both are set), else None."""
+    marker = failed_marker(megatron_path)
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(marker.read_text())
+        mtime = marker.stat().st_mtime
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(data, dict):
+        return None
+    mine, theirs = _launch_id(), data.get("launch")
+    if mine is not None and theirs is not None and mine != theirs:
+        return None
+    return str(data.get("reason")), mtime, theirs
+
+
+def read_failure(megatron_path, since: float | None) -> str | None:
+    """The reason in ``<out>.failed`` when the storage wrote it after ``since`` (a storage time
+    from :func:`_storage_now`, so clock skew between nodes does not matter) and it is not of
+    another launch, else None. An older marker is handled by :class:`FailureWatch`."""
+    found = _marker(megatron_path)
+    if found is None or since is None or found[1] <= since:
+        return None
+    return found[0]
+
+
+class FailureWatch:
+    """A waiting node's view of ``<out>.failed``; :meth:`check` returns rank 0's reason or None.
+
+    * A marker the storage wrote after ``since`` (:func:`read_failure`) stops the node at once.
+    * A marker written before ``since`` (or in the same mtime second, or with no storage time) is
+      taken only when it is still in place and unchanged ``grace`` seconds after this node first
+      saw it: rank 0 removes any marker as its first step (:func:`clear_failure`), so a stale
+      marker of an earlier launch (also one with the same launch id) is gone by then.
+    * A marker of another launch id is never taken.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, megatron_path, since: float | None, grace: float | None = None):
+        self.path = megatron_path
+        self.since = since
+        self.grace = MARKER_GRACE if grace is None else grace
+        self._seen = None  # (mtime, first seen on the monotonic clock) of an older marker
+
+    def check(self) -> str | None:
+        found = _marker(self.path)
+        if found is None:
+            self._seen = None
+            return None
+        reason, mtime, _ = found
+        if self.since is not None and mtime > self.since:
+            return reason
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        if self._seen is None or self._seen[0] != mtime:
+            self._seen = (mtime, now)
+        if now - self._seen[1] >= self.grace:
+            return (
+                f"{reason} (from {failed_marker(self.path)}, written before this node started to wait "
+                f"and not cleared by rank 0 within {self.grace:g} s)"
+            )
+        return None
+
+
+class ConversionFailed(RuntimeError):
+    """Rank 0 stopped (a reason this node computed itself or read from ``<out>.failed``)."""
+
+
+def output_not_empty_reason(megatron_path) -> str | None:
+    """Rank 0 refuses to convert into a non-empty ``<out>`` without a checkpoint tracker (it could
+    be anything); the waiting nodes compute the same reason."""
+    megatron_path = Path(megatron_path)
+    tracker = megatron_path / TRACKER_FILE
+    try:
+        busy = megatron_path.is_dir() and not tracker.exists() and any(megatron_path.iterdir())
+    except OSError:
+        busy = False
+    if busy:
+        return (
+            f"{megatron_path} exists but holds no checkpoint (no {TRACKER_FILE}). "
+            "Delete it or set native_ckpt_out to a new directory."
+        )
+    return None
+
+
+def wait_for_checkpoint(
+    megatron_path: Path,
+    want: dict,
+    timeout: float,
+    poll: float = 5.0,
+    node_rank: int = 1,
+    since: float | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Other nodes: wait until the checkpoint is complete and matches ``want``.
+
+    Stops early (``ConversionFailed``) when rank 0 stops, computing rank 0's refusals itself where
+    it can, so a marker written before this node looked is not needed:
+
+    * the checkpoint has a tracker, no conversion lock, and does not match;
+    * ``<out>`` is not empty and has no tracker, and no lock (rank 0 refuses to write into it);
+    * rank 0 wrote ``<out>.failed`` for this launch (:class:`FailureWatch`), e.g. the lock is held
+      by another launch or the conversion raised.
+
+    Else waits at most ``timeout`` seconds (monotonic clock); the TimeoutError says what was seen.
+    No ``.done`` marker is read, so a ``.done`` of another launch neither releases nor blocks."""
+    megatron_path = Path(megatron_path)
+    tracker = megatron_path / TRACKER_FILE
+    lock_file = lock_path(megatron_path)
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    if since is None:
+        since = _storage_now(megatron_path, node_rank)
+    watch = FailureWatch(megatron_path, since)
+    while True:
+        has_tracker = tracker.exists()  # once per poll, so the reason and the branch agree
+        reason = stale_checkpoint_reason(megatron_path, want) if has_tracker else "no checkpoint yet"
+        if reason is None:
+            return
+        locked = lock_file.exists()
+        if has_tracker and not locked:
+            raise ConversionFailed(
+                f"the checkpoint at {megatron_path} cannot be reused: {reason} (rank 0 stops too)"
+            )
+        busy = output_not_empty_reason(megatron_path)
+        if busy and not locked:
+            raise ConversionFailed(f"{busy} (rank 0 stops too)")
+        failure = watch.check()
+        if failure is not None:
+            raise ConversionFailed(f"rank 0 failed to convert the checkpoint: {failure}")
+        if time.monotonic() - start >= timeout:
+            raise TimeoutError(
+                f"Timeout after {timeout:g} s waiting for rank 0 to prepare {megatron_path}: {reason}; "
+                f"lock {lock_file} {'present' if locked else 'absent'}; no {failed_marker(megatron_path)} "
+                "for this launch. Check rank 0's log; a slow conversion needs a larger native_ckpt_wait_timeout."
+            )
+        time.sleep(poll)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# conversion lock: one owner per output, stale locks of a dead process are taken over
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def lock_path(megatron_path) -> Path:
+    return Path(f"{megatron_path}.converting.lock")
+
+
+def partial_path(megatron_path) -> Path:
+    """Rank 0 converts into this directory and renames it to ``<out>`` when the checkpoint and
+    its record are complete, so ``<out>`` never holds a partial checkpoint."""
+    return Path(f"{megatron_path}.partial")
+
+
+def _pid_namespace() -> str | None:
+    """This process's PID namespace (``/proc/self/ns/pid``), so a pid is compared only with pids
+    of the same namespace (two containers on one host have the same host name, not the same pids)."""
+    try:
+        return os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/pid")
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _pid_alive(pid) -> bool:
+    try:
+        os.kill(int(pid), 0)
+    except ProcessLookupError:
+        return False
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):  # PermissionError is an OSError
+        return True  # cannot tell: treat it as alive
+    return True
+
+
+def _lock_is_stale(held: dict) -> bool:
+    """True only when the owner is certainly not running: same host and PID namespace, and its pid
+    is dead or is this process's pid (this process does not hold the lock yet: a relaunch in a
+    container with the same pid). Any other owner (another host or namespace, unreadable) counts
+    as running."""
+    if held.get("host") != socket.gethostname() or not held.get("pid"):
+        return False
+    if held.get("pidns") != _pid_namespace():
+        return False
+    try:
+        if int(held["pid"]) == os.getpid():
+            return True
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return False
+    return not _pid_alive(held["pid"])
+
+
+_LOCK_TOKENS: dict = {}  # lock path -> the token this process wrote into it
+
+
+# creation attempts in acquire_lock: each failed one found a stale lock and took it aside (or saw
+# another process take it aside first), then the next one tries to create the lock again
+_LOCK_ATTEMPTS = 3
+
+
+def acquire_lock(megatron_path) -> None:
+    """Rank 0: create ``<out>.converting.lock`` with O_EXCL and the owner (host, PID namespace, pid,
+    launch id, time, a random token). A lock whose owner is certainly not running
+    (:func:`_lock_is_stale`) is taken over: it is first renamed to a unique name (only one process
+    can rename it), then checked again; if it changed in between (a new owner), it is put back and
+    this process stops. Any other existing lock raises ``ConversionFailed`` naming the owner and
+    the file to delete, so two launches never convert into the same output."""
+    lock = lock_path(megatron_path)
+    token = os.urandom(8).hex()
+    owner = {
+        "host": socket.gethostname(),
+        "pidns": _pid_namespace(),
+        "pid": os.getpid(),
+        "launch": _launch_id(),
+        "time": time.time(),
+        "token": token,
+    }
+    for _ in range(_LOCK_ATTEMPTS):
+        try:
+            fd = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
+        except FileExistsError:
+            try:
+                raw = lock.read_text()
+                held = json.loads(raw)
+            except (OSError, ValueError):
+                raw, held = None, {}
+            if raw is None or not isinstance(held, dict) or not _lock_is_stale(held):
+                raise ConversionFailed(
+                    f"another conversion holds {lock} (owner: {held or 'unknown'}). If no conversion "
+                    "is running (e.g. a killed launch on another node), delete the lock and launch again."
+                )
+            aside = Path(f"{lock}.stale.{token}")
+            try:
+                os.rename(lock, aside)  # atomic: one process takes the stale lock aside
+            except FileNotFoundError:
+                continue  # another process took it aside first: try to create again
+            try:
+                same = aside.read_text() == raw
+            except OSError:
+                same = False
+            if not same:  # a new owner wrote the lock after it was read: give it back
+                try:
+                    os.link(aside, lock)
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+                aside.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+                raise ConversionFailed(
+                    f"another conversion took {lock} while this one checked it; launch again."
+                )
+            aside.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+            continue
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as fh:
+            fh.write(json.dumps(owner) + "\n")
+        _LOCK_TOKENS[str(lock)] = token
+        return
+    raise ConversionFailed(
+        f"could not take the conversion lock {lock} in {_LOCK_ATTEMPTS} attempts (each found a stale "
+        "lock and took it aside, or saw another process take it aside first); launch again."
+    )
+
+
+def release_lock(megatron_path) -> None:
+    """Remove the lock if this process wrote it (its token is in the file)."""
+    lock = lock_path(megatron_path)
+    token = _LOCK_TOKENS.pop(str(lock), None)
+    if token is None:
+        return
+    try:
+        held = json.loads(lock.read_text())
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return
+    if isinstance(held, dict) and held.get("token") == token:
+        lock.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def run_native_flow(
+    hf_path: str, megatron_path, opts: dict, convert, dtype: str, node_rank: int, log
+) -> None:
+    """Rank 0 converts, the other nodes wait.
+
+    Rank 0 takes ``<out>.converting.lock`` (:func:`acquire_lock`), converts into ``<out>.partial``
+    (``convert(hf_path, str(partial), opts)``), writes ``primus_native_convert.json`` there and
+    renames the directory to ``<out>``. So ``<out>`` holds a complete checkpoint with its record or
+    nothing; a crash leaves only ``<out>.partial``, which the next lock owner deletes. A checkpoint
+    with a tracker is reused only if its record matches this run; else rank 0 stops with what to do.
+    When rank 0 stops (mismatch, lock held, the conversion raises) it writes ``<out>.failed`` with
+    the reason, and the other nodes stop with it instead of waiting for ``native_ckpt_wait_timeout``.
+
+    ``log`` has ``info`` / ``error`` / ``success`` callables. Raises ``ConversionFailed`` (rank 0
+    mismatch or lock held, any node) or the conversion's exception (rank 0) or ``TimeoutError``
+    (other nodes).
+    """
+    megatron_path = Path(megatron_path)
+    tracker = megatron_path / TRACKER_FILE
+    timeout = config_int(opts, "wait_timeout", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
+    if node_rank == 0:
+        # First step: a marker of an earlier launch is removed before anything else (see
+        # FailureWatch: a waiting node takes an older marker only if it stays in place).
+        clear_failure(megatron_path)
+        since = None
+    else:
+        # The storage time before the (slow) record below: a marker rank 0 writes while this node
+        # computes the record still counts.
+        since = _storage_now(megatron_path, node_rank)
+    try:
+        want = convert_record(hf_path, opts, dtype)
+    except Exception as e:
+        if node_rank == 0:
+            write_failure(megatron_path, f"conversion settings: {e}")
+        raise
+
+    if tracker.exists() and stale_checkpoint_reason(megatron_path, want) is None:
+        log.info(f"Native Megatron checkpoint already exists at {megatron_path}, skipping conversion")
+        return
+    if node_rank != 0:
+        log.info(f"[RANK {node_rank}] Waiting for rank 0 to prepare the native checkpoint...")
+        wait_for_checkpoint(megatron_path, want, timeout, node_rank=node_rank, since=since)
+        log.success(f"[RANK {node_rank}] Checkpoint ready at {megatron_path}")
+        return
+
+    def stop(reason):
+        write_failure(megatron_path, reason)
+        raise ConversionFailed(reason)
+
+    def state():
+        """``(reusable, refusal)`` of ``<out>`` from one read of the tracker and the record:
+        ``reusable`` when it holds the wanted checkpoint; else ``refusal`` says why rank 0 cannot
+        convert into it (None: it can). Checked before and again after taking the lock, since
+        another launch can finish between the two."""
+        if tracker.exists():
+            stale = stale_checkpoint_reason(megatron_path, want)
+            if stale is None:
+                return True, None
+            return False, (
+                f"Native Megatron checkpoint at {megatron_path} cannot be reused: {stale}. Delete it "
+                "or set native_ckpt_out to a new directory to convert again."
+            )
+        return False, output_not_empty_reason(megatron_path)
+
+    reusable, reason = state()
+    if reusable:  # written after the check above (another launch)
+        log.info(f"Native Megatron checkpoint already exists at {megatron_path}, skipping conversion")
+        return
+    if reason:
+        stop(reason)
+    log.info("Converting HF checkpoint to Megatron format (native, bridge-free)...")
+    megatron_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    try:
+        acquire_lock(megatron_path)
+    except ConversionFailed as e:
+        stop(str(e))
+    partial = partial_path(megatron_path)
+    try:
+        # again under the lock: a launch that held it may have written <out> meanwhile
+        reusable, reason = state()
+        if reusable:
+            log.info(f"Native Megatron checkpoint written meanwhile at {megatron_path}, skipping conversion")
+            return
+        if reason:
+            stop(reason)
+        if partial.exists():  # left by a killed conversion; this process owns the lock now
+            shutil.rmtree(partial)
+        convert(hf_path, str(partial), opts)
+        (partial / CONVERT_RECORD).write_text(json.dumps(want, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+        if megatron_path.exists():
+            megatron_path.rmdir()  # empty (checked under the lock)
+        os.replace(partial, megatron_path)
+        try:
+            Path(f"{megatron_path}.done").touch()  # informational only; no node reads it
+        except OSError as e:
+            log.info(f"could not write {megatron_path}.done ({e}); the checkpoint is complete")

+    except ConversionFailed:
+        raise
+    except BaseException as e:
+        write_failure(megatron_path, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+        raise
+    finally:
+        release_lock(megatron_path)
+
+
+# --- OLMo-3 given as a Hugging Face hub id ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+_HUB_ID = r"[A-Za-z0-9][\w.-]*/[\w.-]+"
+_HUB_PATTERNS = ["*.json", "*.safetensors"]
+
+
+def is_hub_id(hf_path) -> bool:
+    """``org/name`` that is not a local path."""
+    text = str(hf_path or "")
+    return re.fullmatch(_HUB_ID, text) is not None and not os.path.exists(text)
+
+
+_SHARD_NAME = re.compile(r".+-\d+-of-\d+\.safetensors")
+
+
+def snapshot_incomplete_reason(path) -> str | None:
+    """Why the snapshot directory cannot be converted (None: it can): it needs ``config.json`` and
+    the ``*.safetensors`` weights; with a ``model.safetensors.index.json`` every shard it names.
+    Sharded weight names (``*-00001-of-00003.safetensors``) without the index are incomplete."""
+    path = Path(path)
+    if not (path / "config.json").is_file():
+        return f"{path} has no config.json"
+    index = path / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if index.is_file():
+        try:
+            shards = set(json.loads(index.read_text())["weight_map"].values())
+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
+            return f"{index} cannot be read ({type(e).__name__}: {e})"
+        missing = sorted(s for s in shards if not (path / s).is_file())
+        if missing:
+            return f"{path} lacks {len(missing)} weight shard(s) named in its index, e.g. {missing[0]}"
+        return None
+    weights = sorted(path.glob("*.safetensors"))
+    if not weights:
+        return f"{path} has no *.safetensors weights"
+    # Shard names (model-00001-of-00003.safetensors) mean a sharded checkpoint, whose index is
+    # needed to know the shard set: without it the download is not finished (the index may land
+    # after the first shards while other nodes poll the shared cache).
+    if any(_SHARD_NAME.fullmatch(w.name) for w in weights):
+        return f"{path} has sharded weights but no model.safetensors.index.json (download not finished?)"
+    return None
+
+
+def _snapshot(hub_id: str, local_only: bool):
+    """(path, None) for a complete snapshot of ``hub_id``, else (None, reason)."""
+    try:
+        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+    except ImportError:
+        return None, "huggingface_hub is not installed"
+    try:
+        path = snapshot_download(hub_id, allow_patterns=_HUB_PATTERNS, local_files_only=local_only)
+    except Exception as e:  # not cached / no network
+        where = "in the Hugging Face cache" if local_only else "on the Hugging Face hub"
+        return None, f"{hub_id} not found {where} ({type(e).__name__}: {e})"
+    reason = snapshot_incomplete_reason(path)
+    return (None, reason) if reason else (path, None)
+
+
+def hub_model_type_reason(hub_id: str) -> str | None:
+    """Why ``hub_id`` is not an OLMo-3 checkpoint (None: its config.json says ``olmo3``). Reads only
+    config.json (the cache first, else the hub), so a foreign model's weights are never downloaded."""
+    try:
+        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+    except ImportError:
+        return "huggingface_hub is not installed"
+    config, errors = None, []
+    for local_only in (True, False):
+        try:
+            path = snapshot_download(hub_id, allow_patterns=["config.json"], local_files_only=local_only)
+            config = json.loads((Path(path) / "config.json").read_text())
+            break
+        except Exception as e:  # not cached / no network / not JSON
+            errors.append(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+    if not isinstance(config, dict):
+        return f"cannot read the config.json of {hub_id} ({'; '.join(errors)})"
+    model_type = config.get("model_type")
+    if model_type != "olmo3":
+        return (
+            f"{hub_id} is model_type {model_type!r} (config.json), not olmo3; it cannot load into "
+            "OLMo-3. Point hf_path (else tokenizer_model) at an OLMo-3 checkpoint"
+        )
+    return None
+
+
+def resolve_hub_snapshot(hub_id: str, out, opts: dict, node_rank: int, log, poll: float = 5.0):
+    """A complete local snapshot of the OLMo-3 hub id ``hub_id``, else None (the reason is logged).
+
+    Only rank 0 downloads (the cache first, else the hub). The other nodes do not reach the
+    network: they wait (``native_ckpt_wait_timeout``) until the snapshot is complete in the
+    Hugging Face cache, which must be shared, as ``<out>`` must be. When rank 0 cannot get the
+    snapshot it writes ``<out>.failed`` and the other nodes stop with it (:class:`FailureWatch`).
+    A snapshot is complete with config.json and all its safetensors weights
+    (:func:`snapshot_incomplete_reason`). Rank 0 first reads only config.json: a model that is not
+    OLMo-3 stops there (:func:`hub_model_type_reason`), before any weights are downloaded."""
+    if node_rank == 0:
+        clear_failure(out)  # first step, as in run_native_flow (see FailureWatch)
+        reason = hub_model_type_reason(hub_id)
+        if reason is not None:
+            write_failure(out, reason)
+            log.error(reason)
+            return None
+        path, reason = _snapshot(hub_id, local_only=True)
+        if path is None:
+            log.info(f"{reason}; downloading the config and safetensors weights of {hub_id}")
+            path, reason = _snapshot(hub_id, local_only=False)
+        if path is None:
+            reason = f"cannot get a complete snapshot of {hub_id}: {reason}"
+            write_failure(out, reason)
+            log.error(reason)
+        return path
+    timeout = config_int(opts, "wait_timeout", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
+    watch = FailureWatch(out, _storage_now(out, node_rank))
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    log.info(f"[RANK {node_rank}] Waiting for rank 0 to put {hub_id} in the Hugging Face cache...")
+    while True:
+        path, reason = _snapshot(hub_id, local_only=True)
+        if path is not None:
+            return path
+        failure = watch.check()
+        if failure is not None:
+            log.error(f"[RANK {node_rank}] rank 0 stopped: {failure}")
+            return None
+        if time.monotonic() - start >= timeout:
+            log.error(
+                f"[RANK {node_rank}] no complete snapshot of {hub_id} in the Hugging Face cache after "
+                f"{timeout} s ({reason}); the nodes need a shared cache (HF_HOME)"
+            )
+            return None
+        time.sleep(poll)

+
+"""Native, bridge-free HuggingFace -> Megatron-Core converter for OLMo-3
+(HF ``model_type: olmo3``, e.g. ``allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B``).
+
+Layout differences from Llama / Qwen3 (see ``core/models/olmo3``):
+
+* post-norm: ``post_attention_layernorm`` -> ``self_attention.post_attention_layernorm``
+  and ``post_feedforward_layernorm`` -> ``mlp.post_feedforward_layernorm``;
+  there is no input / pre-MLP norm, so ``linear_qkv`` / ``linear_fc1`` are plain
+  (non-LayerNorm) TE linears;
+* full-width QK-norm: ``self_attn.q_norm`` (width ``heads * head_dim``) / ``k_norm`` (width
+  ``kv_heads * head_dim``) -> ``self_attention.q_norm`` / ``k_norm``;
+* sliding window on 3 of 4 layers and YaRN RoPE on the full layers (no weights).
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import math
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.checkpoint import native_convert_common as common
+from primus.backends.megatron.checkpoint.native_flow_olmo3 import (
+    check_single_shard_layout,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_validation import (
+    YARN_BETA_FAST_DEFAULT,
+    YARN_BETA_SLOW_DEFAULT,
+    check_olmo3_unsupported,
+    olmo3_window_from_settings,
+)
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Converter runtime (the build / save part is common.set_converter_runtime_args, shared by
+# every native converter; the layout and dtype checks are OLMo-3 own)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DTYPES = {"bf16": torch.bfloat16, "fp16": torch.float16, "fp32": torch.float32}
+
+
+def _apply_runtime_margs(m, args) -> None:
+    """The converter's runtime Megatron args: 1 iteration of batch 1; TP = PP = EP = 1 in a 1-rank
+    world (the converter writes a single-shard checkpoint); one dtype from :data:`DTYPES` (an
+    unknown dtype raises; at most one of ``bf16`` / ``fp16`` is True); CPU build without init;
+    fusions off; a legacy ``torch`` checkpoint saved to ``args.save_dir`` without optimizer / RNG
+    state. The dtype and the layout are checked before ``m`` changes."""
+    if args.dtype not in DTYPES:
+        raise ValueError(f"converter dtype must be one of {sorted(DTYPES)}, got {args.dtype!r}")
+    check_single_shard_layout(
+        args.tensor_parallel_size, args.pipeline_parallel_size, args.expert_parallel_size
+    )
+    m.micro_batch_size = 1
+    m.global_batch_size = 1
+    m.train_iters = 1
+
+    m.tensor_model_parallel_size = 1
+    m.pipeline_model_parallel_size = 1
+    m.expert_model_parallel_size = 1
+    m.expert_tensor_parallel_size = 1
+    m.context_parallel_size = 1
+    m.sequence_parallel = False
+    m.world_size = 1
+    m.rank = 0
+    m.bf16 = args.dtype == "bf16"
+    m.fp16 = args.dtype == "fp16"
+    m.params_dtype = DTYPES[args.dtype]
+    common.set_converter_runtime_args(m, args.save_dir)
+
+
+def _window_fields(cfg):
+    """``(sliding_window, window_attn_skip_freq)`` from HF ``sliding_window`` + ``layer_types``.
+
+    ``sliding_window`` is the HF W (keys incl. the current token); the caller stores it as
+    ``olmo3_sliding_window`` and as Megatron's ``window_size = (W - 1, 0)``. ``window_attn_skip_freq``
+    is an int ``k`` (every k-th, 1-indexed, layer is full attention) when the pattern is
+    periodic over all layers, else an explicit 0/1 list (1 = sliding). OLMo-3 has sliding
+    layers, so a config without an int ``sliding_window > 1``, without a ``layer_types``
+    entry per layer, with unknown layer types, or with no sliding layer or no full_attention
+    layer raises ``ValueError``.
+    """
+    n = cfg["num_hidden_layers"]
+    types = cfg.get("layer_types")
+    if not isinstance(types, (list, tuple)) or len(types) != n:
+        got = len(types) if isinstance(types, (list, tuple)) else types
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 config.json needs layer_types with one entry per layer ({n}), got {got!r}")
+    unknown = sorted({t for t in types if t not in _LAYER_TYPES})
+    if unknown:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 layer_types must be {_LAYER_TYPES}, got {unknown}")
+    sliding = [t == "sliding_attention" for t in types]
+    if not any(sliding):
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 layer_types has no sliding_attention layer; not an OLMo-3 layout")
+    if all(sliding):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "OLMo-3 layer_types has no full_attention layer; window_attn_skip_freq needs at least one "
+            "full attention layer"
+        )
+    window = cfg.get("sliding_window")
+    if not isinstance(window, int) or isinstance(window, bool) or window <= 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 has sliding layers but sliding_window is {window!r} (need an int > 1)")
+    for k in range(2, n + 1):
+        if all(s == ((i + 1) % k != 0) for i, s in enumerate(sliding)):
+            return window, k
+    return window, [1 if s else 0 for s in sliding]
+
+
+_REQUIRED_KEYS = (
+    "hidden_size",
+    "num_attention_heads",
+    "num_hidden_layers",
+    "intermediate_size",
+    "max_position_embeddings",
+    "rms_norm_eps",
+)
+_LAYER_TYPES = ("full_attention", "sliding_attention")
+
+
+def _check_hf_config(cfg):
+    """Refuse configs this converter does not map (no biases, SwiGLU only, OLMo-3 only).
+
+    Raises ``ValueError`` (not ``assert``: the checks must survive ``python -O``).
+    """
+    mt = cfg.get("model_type")
+    if mt != "olmo3":
+        raise ValueError(f"native_loader_olmo3 converts model_type 'olmo3', got {mt!r}")
+    act = cfg.get("hidden_act", "silu")
+    if act != "silu":
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 converter supports hidden_act 'silu' (SwiGLU) only, got {act!r}")
+    if cfg.get("attention_bias", False):
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 converter maps no q/k/v/o biases; attention_bias must be false")
+    if cfg.get("tie_word_embeddings", False):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "OLMo-3 converter supports untied embeddings only (tie_word_embeddings must be false); "
+            "the OLMo-3 model refuses untie_embeddings_and_output_weights=false"
+        )
+    missing = [k for k in _REQUIRED_KEYS if cfg.get(k) is None]
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 config.json is missing required keys: {', '.join(missing)}")
+    nh = cfg["num_attention_heads"]
+    ng = cfg.get("num_key_value_heads") or nh
+    if nh % ng:
+        raise ValueError(f"num_attention_heads ({nh}) must be divisible by num_key_value_heads ({ng})")
+
+
+def _rope_type(params):
+    t = params.get("rope_type", params.get("type")) or "default"
+    if t not in ("default", "yarn"):
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 converter supports rope_type 'default' or 'yarn', got {t!r}")
+    return t
+
+
+# Keys each supported rope_type may carry. Any other key (``mscale``, ``mscale_all_dim``,
+# ``long_factor`` ...) changes the HF math in a way this port does not implement, so it is refused
+# instead of dropped. ``truncate`` is an allowed YaRN key, but its value must be true:
+# ``_yarn_params`` refuses ``truncate: false``.
+_ROPE_KEYS = {
+    "default": {"rope_type", "type", "rope_theta"},
+    "yarn": {
+        "rope_type",
+        "type",
+        "rope_theta",
+        "factor",
+        "original_max_position_embeddings",
+        "beta_fast",
+        "beta_slow",
+        "attention_factor",
+        "truncate",
+    },
+}
+
+
+def _yarn_params(params, cfg):
+    """Normalised YaRN values of one rope-parameter dict, with the HF defaults filled in.
+
+    Refuses what Olmo3DualRotaryEmbedding does not implement: unknown keys (``mscale``,
+    ``mscale_all_dim`` ...), ``truncate: false`` (Megatron rounds the correction range, as
+    HF's default ``truncate: true``), ``factor < 1``, ``attention_factor <= 0``,
+    ``beta_fast < beta_slow``, and, when ``original_max_position_embeddings`` is given, a
+    ``factor`` that differs from ``max_position_embeddings / original_max_position_embeddings``.
+    """
+    t = _rope_type(params)
+    extra = sorted(set(params) - _ROPE_KEYS[t])
+    if extra:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 converter: unsupported {t!r} rope parameters {extra}")
+    if t != "yarn":
+        return None
+    if params.get("truncate", True) is not True:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "OLMo-3 converter: YaRN truncate must be true (Megatron rounds the correction range)"
+        )
+    factor = params.get("factor")
+    if isinstance(factor, bool) or not isinstance(factor, (int, float)) or factor < 1.0:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 YaRN factor must be a number >= 1, got {factor!r}")
+    factor = float(factor)
+    max_pos = cfg["max_position_embeddings"]
+    orig = params.get("original_max_position_embeddings")
+    if orig is None:
+        orig = max_pos
+    elif not math.isclose(max_pos / float(orig), factor, rel_tol=1e-9):
+        # also for factor 1.0: HF derives YaRN from this ratio, so 1.0 with orig < max_pos is not "no YaRN"
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"OLMo-3 YaRN factor {factor} != max_position_embeddings / original_max_position_embeddings "
+            f"= {max_pos} / {orig}; refusing an inconsistent rope config"
+        )
+    beta_fast = float(params["beta_fast"] if params.get("beta_fast") is not None else YARN_BETA_FAST_DEFAULT)
+    beta_slow = float(params["beta_slow"] if params.get("beta_slow") is not None else YARN_BETA_SLOW_DEFAULT)
+    if beta_fast < beta_slow:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 YaRN beta_fast ({beta_fast}) must be >= beta_slow ({beta_slow})")
+    af = params.get("attention_factor")
+    if af is not None:
+        if isinstance(af, bool) or not isinstance(af, (int, float)) or not af > 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 YaRN attention_factor must be > 0, got {af!r}")
+        af = float(af)
+    return dict(
+        factor=factor,
+        original_max_position_embeddings=int(orig),
+        beta_fast=beta_fast,
+        beta_slow=beta_slow,
+        attention_factor=af,
+    )
+
+
+def _rope_source(cfg):
+    """The rope-parameter dict of an HF config: ``rope_parameters`` (transformers 5.x) or
+    ``rope_scaling`` (4.57). A key that is present but null counts as absent. Both present: they
+    must be equal (one dict written under both names), else ``ValueError``: one is not dropped in
+    favour of the other. An empty dict is a value (no scaling), not "absent"."""
+    present = {k: cfg[k] for k in ("rope_parameters", "rope_scaling") if cfg.get(k) is not None}
+    for k, v in present.items():
+        if not isinstance(v, dict):
+            raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 {k} must be a dict, got {type(v).__name__}")
+    if len(present) == 2 and present["rope_parameters"] != present["rope_scaling"]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "OLMo-3 config.json has both rope_parameters and rope_scaling and they differ "
+            f"({present['rope_parameters']!r} vs {present['rope_scaling']!r}); refusing to pick one"
+        )
+    return next(iter(present.values()), {})
+
+
+def _rope_config(cfg):
+    """``(full-attention RoPE params, sliding-layer layout or None, rope_theta)`` from an HF config.
+
+    Handles the flat ``rope_scaling`` / ``rope_parameters`` dict (transformers 4.57 checkpoints)
+    and the per-layer-type form ``{"full_attention": {...}, "sliding_attention": {...}}``
+    (transformers 5.x). In the per-type form the sliding layers' own ``rope_type`` gives the
+    layout (``default`` -> ``per_type``, ``yarn`` -> ``yarn_all``); the flat form gives none.
+    Unknown nesting or unsupported RoPE types raise ``ValueError``.
+    """
+    raw = _rope_source(cfg)
+    layout = None
+    if any(isinstance(v, dict) for v in raw.values()):
+        unknown = set(raw) - set(_LAYER_TYPES)
+        if unknown or "full_attention" not in raw:
+            problems = []
+            if unknown:
+                problems.append(f"unknown keys {sorted(unknown)} (allowed: {list(_LAYER_TYPES)})")
+            if "full_attention" not in raw:
+                problems.append("the required 'full_attention' entry is missing")
+            raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 per-layer-type rope parameters ({sorted(raw)}): " + "; ".join(problems))
+        full = raw["full_attention"]
+        sliding = raw.get("sliding_attention")
+        for name, entry in (("full_attention", full), ("sliding_attention", sliding)):
+            if entry is not None and not isinstance(entry, dict):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"OLMo-3 rope parameters {name!r} must be a dict, got {type(entry).__name__}"
+                )
+        if full is None:
+            raise ValueError("OLMo-3 rope parameters: 'full_attention' is null")
+        if sliding is not None:
+            st = _rope_type(sliding)
+            if st == "yarn" and _rope_type(full) == "yarn":
+                layout = "yarn_all"
+            elif st == "default":
+                layout = "per_type"
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("OLMo-3: YaRN on sliding layers needs YaRN on full layers too")
+            if sliding.get("rope_theta", full.get("rope_theta")) != full.get("rope_theta"):
+                raise ValueError("OLMo-3 converter needs one rope_theta for all layer types")
+            # yarn_all builds one YaRN table (and attention factor) for every layer: the sliding
+            # layers' YaRN values must be the full layers' ones, not silently replaced by them.
+            ys, yf = _yarn_params(sliding, cfg), _yarn_params(full, cfg)
+            if ys is not None and ys != yf:
+                diff = sorted(k for k in ys if ys[k] != yf[k])
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"OLMo-3 converter: sliding_attention YaRN parameters {diff} differ from "
+                    "full_attention; yarn_all uses one YaRN table for all layers"
+                )
+    else:
+        full = raw
+    _rope_type(full)
+    # transformers 5.x may write ``rope_theta: null`` at the top level and the value in the
+    # rope parameters: None counts as missing; two different values are refused.
+    top, nested = cfg.get("rope_theta"), full.get("rope_theta")
+    if top is not None and nested is not None and float(top) != float(nested):
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 config.json: rope_theta {top} differs from the rope parameters' {nested}")
+    theta = top if top is not None else nested
+    if theta is None:
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 config.json has no rope_theta (top level or in the rope parameters)")
+    return full, layout, float(theta)
+
+
+def derive_megatron_fields(cfg, rope_layout=None, default_layout="auto"):
+    """Translate an OLMo-3 HF config dict into Megatron arg values.
+
+    RoPE layout (``olmo3_rope_layout``):
+
+    * a config with per-layer-type rope parameters (transformers 5.x) declares its layout, and
+      that layout is used; an explicit ``rope_layout`` that disagrees raises ``ValueError``;
+    * a flat config (transformers 4.57) declares none: ``rope_layout`` when given, else
+      ``default_layout``.
+
+    ``default_layout="auto"`` follows the installed transformers and logs the resolved layout
+    (a ``logging`` warning from :func:`resolve_olmo3_rope_layout`). It exists
+    for parity tests that build the Primus model and compare it against the installed
+    transformers' ``Olmo3ForCausalLM``. Everything that trains or saves passes a concrete
+    layout: :func:`convert` refuses ``auto`` and uses ``per_type`` (the trained model) for a
+    flat config, the model preset sets ``per_type``, and the OLMo-3 args patch refuses
+    ``auto``. ``yarn_all`` on a config without YaRN is refused when asked for explicitly; when
+    ``auto`` resolves to it, the layout is ``per_type`` (the same model). The result is always
+    a concrete layout.
+    """
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_transformer_config import (
+        resolve_olmo3_rope_layout,
+    )
+
+    _check_hf_config(cfg)
+    rope, cfg_layout, rotary_base = _rope_config(cfg)
+    yarn = _yarn_params(rope, cfg)
+    yarn_scales = yarn is not None and yarn["factor"] > 1.0
+    if cfg_layout is not None:
+        if rope_layout not in (None, "auto") and rope_layout != cfg_layout:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 config declares olmo3_rope_layout {cfg_layout!r} through its per-layer-type "
+                f"rope parameters, but {rope_layout!r} was requested"
+            )
+        layout = cfg_layout
+    else:
+        explicit = rope_layout is not None and rope_layout != "auto"
+        layout = resolve_olmo3_rope_layout(rope_layout if rope_layout is not None else default_layout)
+        if layout == "yarn_all" and not yarn_scales:
+            if explicit:
+                raise ValueError("olmo3_rope_layout 'yarn_all' needs YaRN rope parameters (factor > 1)")
+            layout = "per_type"
+    sliding_window, skip_freq = _window_fields(cfg)
+    nh = cfg["num_attention_heads"]
+    return dict(
+        hidden_size=cfg["hidden_size"],
+        num_attention_heads=nh,
+        num_layers=cfg["num_hidden_layers"],
+        max_position_embeddings=cfg["max_position_embeddings"],
+        norm_epsilon=cfg["rms_norm_eps"],
+        rotary_base=rotary_base,
+        untie_embeddings_and_output_weights=True,  # _check_hf_config: tie_word_embeddings is false
+        ffn_hidden_size=cfg["intermediate_size"],
+        num_query_groups=cfg.get("num_key_value_heads") or nh,
+        kv_channels=cfg.get("head_dim") or cfg["hidden_size"] // nh,
+        add_qkv_bias=False,  # _check_hf_config: attention_bias is false
+        # Megatron / TE convention (W - 1, 0) by the shared window reader; the HF W is kept in
+        # olmo3_sliding_window.
+        window_size=olmo3_window_from_settings(None, sliding_window)[0],
+        olmo3_sliding_window=sliding_window,
+        olmo3_window_size_form="megatron",
+        window_attn_skip_freq=skip_freq,
+        olmo3_yarn_rotary_scaling_factor=yarn["factor"] if yarn else 1.0,
+        olmo3_yarn_original_max_position_embeddings=(
+            yarn["original_max_position_embeddings"] if yarn else int(cfg["max_position_embeddings"])
+        ),
+        olmo3_yarn_beta_fast=yarn["beta_fast"] if yarn else YARN_BETA_FAST_DEFAULT,
+        olmo3_yarn_beta_slow=yarn["beta_slow"] if yarn else YARN_BETA_SLOW_DEFAULT,
+        olmo3_yarn_attention_factor=yarn["attention_factor"] if yarn else None,
+        olmo3_rope_layout=layout,
+    )
+
+
+# Upstream Megatron args (``--window-size``, ``--window-attn-skip-freq``): set before validate_args.
+_UPSTREAM_WINDOW_FIELDS = ("window_size", "window_attn_skip_freq")
+# Primus-only OLMo-3 fields (no argparse option): set after validate_args.
+_OLMO3_FIELDS = (
+    "olmo3_sliding_window",
+    "olmo3_window_size_form",
+    "olmo3_yarn_rotary_scaling_factor",
+    "olmo3_yarn_original_max_position_embeddings",
+    "olmo3_yarn_beta_fast",
+    "olmo3_yarn_beta_slow",
+    "olmo3_yarn_attention_factor",
+    "olmo3_rope_layout",
+)
+
+
+def build_margs(cfg_fields, args):
+    from megatron.training.arguments import add_megatron_arguments, validate_args
+
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
+    p = add_megatron_arguments(p)
+    m = p.parse_args([])
+
+    m.model_type = "olmo3"
+    m.hidden_size = cfg_fields["hidden_size"]
+    m.num_attention_heads = cfg_fields["num_attention_heads"]
+    m.num_layers = cfg_fields["num_layers"]
+    m.norm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    m.layernorm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    m.ffn_hidden_size = cfg_fields["ffn_hidden_size"]
+    m.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights = cfg_fields["untie_embeddings_and_output_weights"]
+    # The YaRN factor is max_position_embeddings / original_max_position_embeddings: a longer
+    # seq_length would need another factor, so it is refused, not silently raised.

+            f"{cfg_fields['max_position_embeddings']} of the HF config (the YaRN factor is fitted to it)"

+    m.normalization = "RMSNorm"

+    m.add_qkv_bias = cfg_fields["add_qkv_bias"]
+    m.position_embedding_type = "rope"
+    m.rotary_base = cfg_fields["rotary_base"]

+    m.hidden_dropout = 0.0

+    # result with the same table the args patch, the config and the builder use.
+    check_olmo3_unsupported(m)

+def build_model(margs):
+    """The OLMo-3 model (``get_model_provider('olmo3')``) through the shared builder.
+
+    Kept as a module-level entry point: the parity tooling builds a family's own model through
+    ``<converter>.build_model``; the plain GPT model would not have the OLMo-3 layers.
+    """
+    from primus.core.utils.import_utils import get_model_provider
+
+    model = get_model_provider(model_type="olmo3")(pre_process=True, post_process=True)
+    return model.to(margs.params_dtype)

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HF -> mcore weight mapping
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, _cfg_fields, log):
+    """HF tensors -> mcore names. ``_cfg_fields`` is unused (kept for the shared converter API)."""
+    dtype = margs.params_dtype
+    # Read from the parameter, not model.state_dict(): state_dict() collects TE _extra_state, and
+    # TE's get_extra_state synchronises the GPU (it fails on a host without one).
+    padded_vocab = model.embedding.word_embeddings.weight.shape[0]
+
+    nh = margs.num_attention_heads
+    ng = margs.num_query_groups
+    hdim = margs.kv_channels
+    hidden = margs.hidden_size
+    sd = {}
+    consumed = set()
+
+    def get(name):
+        consumed.add(name)
+        return store.get(name, dtype)
+
+    def fused_qkv(layer):
+        a = f"model.layers.{layer}.self_attn."
+        return common.fuse_qkv(
+            get(a + "q_proj.weight"), get(a + "k_proj.weight"), get(a + "v_proj.weight"), nh, ng, hdim, hidden
+        )
+
+    sd["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get("model.embed_tokens.weight"), padded_vocab)
+    sd["decoder.final_layernorm.weight"] = get("model.norm.weight")
+    # untied only: _check_hf_config refuses tie_word_embeddings
+    sd["output_layer.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get("lm_head.weight"), padded_vocab)
+
+    for L in range(margs.num_layers):
+        p = f"decoder.layers.{L}."
+        h = f"model.layers.{L}."
+        sd[p + "self_attention.linear_qkv.weight"] = fused_qkv(L)
+        sd[p + "self_attention.q_norm.weight"] = get(h + "self_attn.q_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "self_attention.k_norm.weight"] = get(h + "self_attn.k_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "self_attention.linear_proj.weight"] = get(h + "self_attn.o_proj.weight")
+        sd[p + "self_attention.post_attention_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "post_attention_layernorm.weight")
+        sd[p + "mlp.linear_fc1.weight"] = torch.cat(
+            [get(h + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"), get(h + "mlp.up_proj.weight")], dim=0
+        ).contiguous()
+        sd[p + "mlp.linear_fc2.weight"] = get(h + "mlp.down_proj.weight")
+        sd[p + "mlp.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "post_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
+        if L % 5 == 0 or L == margs.num_layers - 1:
+            log(f"  mapped layer {L:2d}")
+
+    return sd, consumed
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# In-process entrypoint
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def convert(
+    hf_dir,
+    save_dir,
+    *,
+    dtype="bf16",
+    tensor_parallel_size=1,
+    pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+    expert_parallel_size=1,
+    seq_length=4096,
+    make_vocab_size_divisible_by=128,
+    master_port=29563,
+    rope_layout=None,
+    log=None,
+):
+    """Convert an OLMo-3 HF checkpoint to a legacy Megatron torch ckpt (single process, CPU).
+
+    Writes a single-shard checkpoint: TP = PP = EP = 1 (reshard a torch_dist
+    checkpoint for other layouts). The saved args carry a concrete
+    ``olmo3_rope_layout``, never ``auto`` (refused): the layout the config's
+    per-layer-type rope parameters declare (transformers 5.x; a different
+    ``rope_layout`` raises), else ``rope_layout`` if given, else ``per_type``
+    (the trained model; flat 4.57-style configs).
+    """
+    if rope_layout == "auto":
+        raise ValueError(
+            "convert() writes a checkpoint: olmo3_rope_layout must be per_type or yarn_all, not auto"
+        )
+    # TP = PP = EP = 1 (also enforced in _apply_runtime_margs); checked first to fail fast.
+    check_single_shard_layout(tensor_parallel_size, pipeline_parallel_size, expert_parallel_size)
+    if log is None:
+
+        def log(*a):
+            print("[olmo3-convert]", *a, flush=True)
+
+    common.ensure_megatron_on_path()
+    common.assert_bridge_free("entry")
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        hf_dir=hf_dir,
+        save_dir=save_dir,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
+        pipeline_parallel_size=pipeline_parallel_size,
+        expert_parallel_size=expert_parallel_size,
+        seq_length=seq_length,
+        make_vocab_size_divisible_by=make_vocab_size_divisible_by,
+    )
+    cfg = common.read_hf_config(hf_dir)
+    cfg_fields = derive_megatron_fields(cfg, rope_layout=rope_layout, default_layout="per_type")
+    log(f"arch: {cfg_fields}")
+    margs = build_margs(cfg_fields, args)
+    margs = common.init_megatron_single_process(margs, master_port, log=log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-init")
+    model = build_model(margs)
+    store = common.SafetensorsStore(hf_dir)
+    sd, consumed = build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log)
+    common.load_validate_save(model, sd, consumed, store, margs, save_dir, log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-save")
+    return save_dir

+def check_olmo3_build_args(args):
+    """Refuse build settings the OLMo-3 builder does not implement (before any config is built)."""
+    if getattr(args, "use_legacy_models", False):
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 requires use_legacy_models=False (Mcore-only).")
+    # The OLMo-3 spec owns post-norms, full-width q/k norms and the per-layer RoPE pick from the
+    # stacked [2, ...] table; a generic spec would silently drop all of them.
+    if getattr(args, "spec", None) is not None:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 builds its own layer spec; unset spec (got {args.spec!r}).")
+    if getattr(args, "mtp_num_layers", None):
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 has no MTP layers; unset mtp_num_layers.")
+    if getattr(args, "yaml_cfg", None) is not None:
+        # core_transformer_config_from_yaml builds a plain TransformerConfig without the OLMo-3
+        # fields (sliding window W and its form, YaRN on full layers, RoPE layout).
+        raise ValueError(
+            "OLMo-3 builds its config from args (Olmo3TransformerConfig); yaml_cfg is not supported."
+        )
