+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 has no ModelOpt builder; unset modelopt_enabled.")
+    if getattr(args, "experimental_attention_variant", None) is not None:
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 attention is fixed; unset experimental_attention_variant.")
+    if getattr(args, "heterogeneous_layers_config_path", None) is not None:
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 layers are homogeneous; unset heterogeneous_layers_config_path.")
+    # The same table the args patch and Olmo3TransformerConfig use. The window is checked on the
+    # config (Olmo3TransformerConfig.__post_init__, or _check_supplied_config).
+    check_olmo3_unsupported(args)
+
+
+def olmo3_layer_plan(config) -> str:
+    """One token per layer, 1-indexed: ``S`` = sliding window (W keys), ``F`` = full attention;
+    ``+yarn`` marks layers with the YaRN table. E.g. ``W=4096 rope=per_type S S S F+yarn``."""
+    yarn = config.olmo3_yarn_enabled
+    tokens = []
+    for n in range(1, config.num_layers + 1):
+        sliding = olmo3_layer_is_sliding(config, n)
+        with_yarn = yarn and (not sliding or config.olmo3_rope_layout == "yarn_all")
+        tokens.append(("S" if sliding else "F") + ("+yarn" if with_yarn else ""))
+    return f"W={config.olmo3_sliding_window} rope={config.olmo3_rope_layout} " + " ".join(tokens)
+
+
+def _core_attention_window(core_attention):
+    """The window the built core attention applies: TE keeps ``window_size``; upstream's local
+    DotProductAttention keeps it on its ``scale_mask_softmax``. ``"full"`` = no window (full causal
+    attention), ``[left, right]`` = a window, ``"unknown"`` = not readable."""
+    for owner in (core_attention, getattr(core_attention, "scale_mask_softmax", None)):
+        if owner is not None and hasattr(owner, "window_size"):
+            w = owner.window_size
+            # None, or TE's "no window" forms (-1, -1) / (-1, 0)
+            return "full" if w is None or int(w[0]) < 0 else [int(x) for x in w]
+    return "unknown"  # no window attribute (another TE version, a Turbo spec): not an error
+
+
+def _core_attention_scale(core_attention):
+    """The softmax scale the built core attention applies. Local DotProductAttention keeps it on
+    itself; TE's DotProductAttention hands it to its backends (flash / fused / unfused), which
+    keep it. ``None`` if no module keeps one; ``"mixed"`` if they disagree (reported, not raised)."""
+    found = {
+        float(m.softmax_scale)
+        for m in core_attention.modules()
+        if isinstance(getattr(m, "softmax_scale", None), (int, float))
+    }
+    if len(found) > 1:
+        return "mixed"
+    return found.pop() if found else None
+
+
+def _read_or_unknown(read):
+    """``read()``, or ``"unknown"`` if it raises (a module tree this report does not know)."""
+    try:
+        return read()
+    except Exception:  # diagnostic only
+        return "unknown"
+
+
+def olmo3_built_layer_report(model) -> list:
+    """Diagnostic, opt-in (see olmo3_builder): per decoder layer of this model chunk, the window and
+    softmax scale its core attention really uses, and which RoPE table it takes. Read from the
+    modules, not the config, so a test or log reader sees what runs.
+
+    Each value is read on its own; a value that cannot be read (missing attribute, unexpected type)
+    is reported as ``"unknown"``. A model without ``decoder.layers`` gives ``[]``; without ``config``
+    each layer's ``rope`` is ``"unknown"``. So the function does not raise for an unexpected module
+    tree."""
+    report = []
+    yarn = _read_or_unknown(lambda: bool(model.config.olmo3_yarn_enabled))  # factor 1: tables agree
+    layers = _read_or_unknown(lambda: list(model.decoder.layers))
+    for layer in layers if isinstance(layers, list) else []:
+        att = getattr(layer, "self_attention", None)
+        core = getattr(att, "core_attention", None)
+        scale = _read_or_unknown(lambda: _core_attention_scale(core))
+        source = "core_attention"
+        if scale is None and isinstance(getattr(att, "softmax_scale", None), (int, float)):
+            # Some TE builds keep no scale attribute on the module tree; then report the scale the
+            # layer handed to its core attention (the softmax_scale kwarg; see Olmo3SelfAttention).
+            scale, source = float(att.softmax_scale), "passed"
+
+        def rope():
+            if yarn == "unknown":
+                return "unknown"
+            return "yarn" if bool(att.olmo3_use_yarn) and yarn else "plain"
+
+        report.append(
+            {
+                "layer": _read_or_unknown(lambda: int(layer.layer_number)),
+                "window": _read_or_unknown(lambda: _core_attention_window(core)),
+                "softmax_scale": scale,
+                "softmax_scale_source": source,
+                "rope": _read_or_unknown(rope),
+            }
+        )
+    return report
+
+
+def _check_supplied_config(config):
+    """A config passed in may have been changed after ``__post_init__``: check it again."""
+    if not isinstance(config, Olmo3TransformerConfig):
+        raise TypeError(f"OLMo-3 needs an Olmo3TransformerConfig, got {type(config).__name__}")
+    check_olmo3_unsupported(config)
+    if config.olmo3_sliding_window is None:
+        raise ValueError("OLMo-3 config needs olmo3_sliding_window (the HF sliding window W)")
+    olmo3_window_from_settings(config.window_size, config.olmo3_sliding_window, config.olmo3_window_size_form)
+    parse_olmo3_skip_freq(config.window_attn_skip_freq, config.num_layers)
+
+
+def olmo3_builder(
+    args,
+    pre_process,
+    post_process,
+    vp_stage=None,
+    config: Optional[Olmo3TransformerConfig] = None,
+    pg_collection=None,
+):
+    """Build an OLMo-3 model."""
+    print_rank_0("[Primus:OLMo-3] building Olmo3Model...")
+    check_olmo3_build_args(args)
+    if config is None:
+        config = core_transformer_config_from_args(args, config_class=Olmo3TransformerConfig)
+    else:
+        _check_supplied_config(config)
+    layer_spec = get_olmo3_layer_spec()
+    print_rank_0(f"[Primus:OLMo-3] layer plan: {olmo3_layer_plan(config)}")
+
+    model = Olmo3Model(
+        config=config,
+        transformer_layer_spec=layer_spec,
+        vocab_size=args.padded_vocab_size,
+        max_sequence_length=args.max_position_embeddings,
+        pre_process=pre_process,
+        post_process=post_process,
+        fp16_lm_cross_entropy=args.fp16_lm_cross_entropy,
+        parallel_output=True,
+        share_embeddings_and_output_weights=not args.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights,
+        position_embedding_type=args.position_embedding_type,
+        rotary_percent=getattr(args, "rotary_percent", 1.0),
+        rotary_base=args.rotary_base,
+        pg_collection=pg_collection,
+        vp_stage=vp_stage,
+    )
+    if layer_report_enabled():
+        _print_built_layer_report(model, vp_stage)
+    return model
+
+
+# Opt-in diagnostic, set by tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py::test_olmo_3_1025_7B. A switch
+# (arg_utils.parse_optional_switch: 1 / true / yes / on, 0 / false / no / off, any case; unset or "" is off;
+# another value is off with a warning: a diagnostic never stops a run).
+OLMO3_LAYER_REPORT_ENV = "PRIMUS_OLMO3_LAYER_REPORT"
+
+
+def layer_report_enabled() -> bool:
+    """True when ``PRIMUS_OLMO3_LAYER_REPORT`` is on. A value that is not a switch counts as off
+    and logs one warning, so a typo cannot fail the run after the model is built."""
+    try:
+        return parse_optional_switch(os.environ.get(OLMO3_LAYER_REPORT_ENV), OLMO3_LAYER_REPORT_ENV)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        warnings.warn(f"{e}; the OLMo-3 layer report is off", stacklevel=2)
+        return False
+
+
+def _print_built_layer_report(model, vp_stage):
+    """One JSON line per model chunk built on global rank 0, i.e. the layers of the first pipeline
+    stage only; with virtual pipeline stages each chunk prints its own line, labelled with its
+    ``vp_stage``. A failure to read the modules is logged; it never stops the build."""
+    label = "" if vp_stage is None else f" (vp_stage {vp_stage})"
+    try:
+        report = json.dumps(olmo3_built_layer_report(model))
+    except Exception as e:  # diagnostic only
+        print_rank_0(f"[Primus:OLMo-3] built layers{label}: not reported ({type(e).__name__}: {e})")
+        return
+    print_rank_0(f"[Primus:OLMo-3] built layers{label}: {report}")
+
+
+def _upstream_model_provider():
+    try:
+        from model_provider import model_provider as upstream
+    except ModuleNotFoundError as e:
+        if e.name != "model_provider":  # a dependency of model_provider is missing: a real error
+            raise
+        return None  # older Megatron: no model_provider module
+    return upstream
+
+
+def model_provider(
+    model_builder=None,
+    pre_process: bool = True,
+    post_process: bool = True,
+    vp_stage: Optional[int] = None,
+    config: Optional[Olmo3TransformerConfig] = None,
+    pg_collection=None,
+):
+    """``model_provider`` entry point used by Megatron's ``pretrain()``.
+
+    Delegates to upstream ``model_provider`` so its setup (``record_memory_history``, ...) runs.
+    """
+    if model_builder is None:
+        model_builder = olmo3_builder
+    args = get_args()
+    # Checked here too: upstream model_provider takes its ModelOpt branch (has_nvidia_modelopt and
+    # modelopt_enabled) without calling model_builder, so olmo3_builder's checks would not run.
+    check_olmo3_build_args(args)
+    upstream = _upstream_model_provider()
+    if upstream is not None:
+        return upstream(
+            model_builder, pre_process, post_process, vp_stage, config=config, pg_collection=pg_collection
+        )
+    if getattr(args, "record_memory_history", False):
+        raise ValueError("record_memory_history needs Megatron's model_provider module")
+    return model_builder(
+        args, pre_process, post_process, vp_stage, config=config, pg_collection=pg_collection
+    )

+"""OLMo-3 layer spec (Transformer Engine).
+
+Post-norm layout: no input / pre-MLP norm (``IdentityOp``); the attention and
+the MLP each normalise their own output before the residual add.
+"""
+
+from megatron.core.extensions import transformer_engine_spec_provider
+from megatron.core.fusions.fused_bias_dropout import get_bias_dropout_add
+from megatron.core.transformer.attention import SelfAttentionSubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnMaskType
+from megatron.core.transformer.identity_op import IdentityOp
+from megatron.core.transformer.mlp import MLPSubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import (
+    TransformerLayer,
+    TransformerLayerSubmodules,
+)
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.olmo3.olmo3_attention import (
+    Olmo3SelfAttention,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.olmo3.olmo3_mlp import Olmo3MLP
+
+__all__ = ["get_olmo3_layer_spec"]
+
+
+def get_olmo3_layer_spec() -> ModuleSpec:
+    """TE layer spec of OLMo-3 (fixed: per-layer window / RoPE choices live in the config and
+    are applied by ``Olmo3SelfAttention``).
+
+    The modules come from ``transformer_engine_spec_provider.TESpecProvider``, read at call time,
+    as upstream's GPT spec does: the Primus Turbo patch rebinds it to ``PrimusTurboSpecProvider``,
+    so ``use_turbo_gemm`` (Turbo linears) applies to OLMo-3's QKV / proj / fc1 / fc2 too. The
+    q/k norms are ``FullWidthRMSNorm`` (owned by the attention); the post-norms are the
+    provider's ``layer_norm()``.
+    """
+    backend = transformer_engine_spec_provider.TESpecProvider()
+    norm = backend.layer_norm()
+    return ModuleSpec(
+        module=TransformerLayer,
+        submodules=TransformerLayerSubmodules(
+            input_layernorm=IdentityOp,
+            self_attention=ModuleSpec(
+                module=Olmo3SelfAttention,
+                params={"attn_mask_type": AttnMaskType.causal, "post_norm": norm},
+                submodules=SelfAttentionSubmodules(
+                    linear_qkv=backend.column_parallel_linear(),
+                    core_attention=backend.core_attention(),
+                    linear_proj=backend.row_parallel_linear(),
+                    q_layernorm=None,
+                    k_layernorm=None,
+                ),
+            ),
+            self_attn_bda=get_bias_dropout_add,
+            pre_mlp_layernorm=IdentityOp,
+            mlp=ModuleSpec(
+                module=Olmo3MLP,
+                params={"post_norm": norm},
+                submodules=MLPSubmodules(
+                    linear_fc1=backend.column_parallel_linear(),
+                    linear_fc2=backend.row_parallel_linear(),
+                ),
+            ),
+            mlp_bda=get_bias_dropout_add,
+        ),
+    )

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Two RoPE tables for OLMo-3: plain RoPE (sliding layers) and YaRN (full layers).
+
+``forward`` returns ``torch.stack([rope, yarn])`` of shape ``[2, s, 1, 1, d]``;
+:class:`Olmo3SelfAttention` selects index 0 or 1 for its layer. The YaRN
+attention (concentration) factor is *not* applied here: ``get_emb`` calls only
+``YarnRotaryEmbedding.get_emb`` (never its ``forward``), keeps the frequency table
+and drops the concentration factor it returns (with ``mscale=1``, ``mscale_all_dim=0`` that
+value is ``0.1 * ln(factor) + 1``, about 1.208 for factor 8, not 1; ``mscale``
+does not change the frequencies). The attention applies the factor once, through
+``softmax_scale *= m**2``; do not also scale by the returned value.
+
+``get_emb`` returns the same stacked table (before CP slicing). ``get_cos_sin``
+(used only by Megatron's flash-decode / FlashInfer inference paths) has no
+per-layer form and raises.
+"""
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core.models.common.embeddings.rope_utils import (
+    get_pos_emb_on_this_cp_rank,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.common.embeddings.rotary_pos_embedding import RotaryEmbedding
+from megatron.core.models.common.embeddings.yarn_rotary_pos_embedding import (
+    YarnRotaryEmbedding,
+)
+from torch import Tensor
+
+__all__ = ["Olmo3DualRotaryEmbedding"]
+
+
+class Olmo3DualRotaryEmbedding(RotaryEmbedding):
+    def __init__(self, config, *, rotary_base: float, rotary_percent: float = 1.0, cp_group=None):
+        # HF OLMo-3 rotates the full head dim (partial_rotary_factor 1); a partial rotary would be
+        # a different model, so refuse it instead of ignoring it.
+        if rotary_percent is not None and float(rotary_percent) != 1.0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 RoPE covers the full head dim; rotary_percent must be 1.0, got {rotary_percent}"
+            )
+        super().__init__(
+            kv_channels=config.kv_channels,
+            rotary_percent=1.0,
+            rotary_interleaved=False,
+            rotary_base=rotary_base,
+            use_cpu_initialization=config.use_cpu_initialization,
+            cp_group=cp_group,
+        )
+        self.olmo3_yarn = None
+        if config.olmo3_yarn_enabled:
+            self.olmo3_yarn = YarnRotaryEmbedding(
+                kv_channels=config.kv_channels,
+                rotary_percent=1.0,
+                rotary_interleaved=False,
+                rotary_base=rotary_base,
+                use_cpu_initialization=config.use_cpu_initialization,
+                scaling_factor=float(config.olmo3_yarn_rotary_scaling_factor),
+                original_max_position_embeddings=int(config.olmo3_yarn_original_max_position_embeddings),
+                beta_fast=float(config.olmo3_yarn_beta_fast),
+                beta_slow=float(config.olmo3_yarn_beta_slow),
+                mscale=1.0,
+                mscale_all_dim=0.0,
+                correction_range_round_to_int=True,
+                cp_group=cp_group,
+            )
+
+    def get_emb(self, max_seq_len: int, offset: int = 0) -> Tensor:
+        """Stacked ``[2, s, 1, 1, d]`` table (index 0 plain RoPE, index 1 YaRN), before CP slicing."""
+        rope = super().get_emb(max_seq_len, offset)
+        if self.olmo3_yarn is not None:
+            yarn, _ = self.olmo3_yarn.get_emb(max_seq_len, offset)
+            yarn = yarn.to(rope.dtype)
+        else:
+            yarn = rope
+        return torch.stack([rope, yarn], dim=0)
+
+    def get_cos_sin(self, max_seq_len: int, offset: int = 0):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "OLMo-3 uses a different RoPE table per layer type; the single cos/sin cache used by "
+            "flash_decode / FlashInfer fused RoPE is not supported. Disable flash_decode."
+        )
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=32)
+    def forward(self, max_seq_len: int, offset: int = 0, packed_seq: bool = False, cp_group=None) -> Tensor:
+        if cp_group is None:
+            cp_group = self.cp_group
+        emb = self.get_emb(max_seq_len, offset)
+        if cp_group is not None and cp_group.size() > 1 and not packed_seq:
+            emb = get_pos_emb_on_this_cp_rank(emb, 1, cp_group)
+        return emb

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""OLMo-3 transformer config.
+
+OLMo-3 (HF ``model_type: olmo3``) differs from the Llama layout in four ways:
+
+* post-norm: ``post_attention_layernorm`` / ``post_feedforward_layernorm`` are
+  applied to each sublayer *output* before the residual add; there is no
+  pre-norm on the sublayer input;
+* QK-norm over the **full** projection width (``num_heads * head_dim``), not
+  per head;
+* sliding-window attention on three of every four layers
+  (``window_attn_skip_freq``) and full attention on the rest;
+* plain RoPE on the sliding layers and YaRN RoPE on the full layers.
+
+Window: ``olmo3_sliding_window`` is the HF ``sliding_window`` W (visible keys
+including the current token, 4096 for OLMo-3). ``window_size`` holds the upstream
+Megatron / TE ``(left, right)`` convention ``(W - 1, 0)``, so every upstream consumer
+(TE / local DotProductAttention, saved args) reads it correctly. Only the HF boundary
+(converter, model preset, args patch) uses W.
+
+The YaRN fields carry an ``olmo3_`` prefix on purpose: upstream
+``Attention`` multiplies RoPE by a YaRN concentration factor on **every**
+layer whenever the config has ``yarn_rotary_scaling_factor``; OLMo-3 needs it on
+the full-attention layers only, which the OLMo-3 attention applies itself.
+"""
+
+import logging
+import math
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_validation import (
+    YARN_BETA_FAST_DEFAULT,
+    YARN_BETA_SLOW_DEFAULT,
+    check_olmo3_unsupported,
+    olmo3_window_from_settings,
+    parse_olmo3_skip_freq,
+)
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OLMO3_ROPE_LAYOUTS",
+    "Olmo3TransformerConfig",
+    "yarn_attention_factor",
+    "resolve_olmo3_rope_layout",
+]
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+OLMO3_ROPE_LAYOUTS = ("per_type", "yarn_all")
+
+
+# transformers' Olmo3 RoPE layout by version. Measured points (logprob parity against the HF model):
+# 4.57 builds plain RoPE on sliding layers and YaRN on full ones (per_type); 5.10 builds one YaRN
+# table for every layer (yarn_all).
+# The bounds 5.0 and 5.13 are unverified (no installed 5.0 or 5.13 was tested). Olmo3 first ships in 4.57; older
+# versions are refused, and so is a pre-release at a bound. ``auto`` is a parity-tool convenience
+# only; training sets the layout.
+_OLMO3_FIRST_TRANSFORMERS = (4, 57)
+_YARN_ALL_TRANSFORMERS = ((5, 0), (5, 13))  # [first, end)
+
+
+def _rope_layout_of_installed_transformers() -> tuple:
+    """(layout, version): the layout the installed transformers' ``Olmo3Model`` uses (for ``auto``
+    only) and the transformers version it was read from."""
+    try:
+        import transformers
+    except ImportError as e:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "olmo3_rope_layout: auto needs transformers installed; set per_type or yarn_all"
+        ) from e
+    text = transformers.__version__
+    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:\.\d+)*(.*)", text.strip())
+    if m is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"olmo3_rope_layout: auto cannot parse transformers version {text!r}; set per_type or yarn_all"
+        )
+    ver, suffix = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))), m.group(3)
+    if ver < _OLMO3_FIRST_TRANSFORMERS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"olmo3_rope_layout: auto: transformers {text} has no Olmo3 model (it needs >= 4.57); "
+            "set per_type or yarn_all"
+        )
+    first, end = _YARN_ALL_TRANSFORMERS
+    if suffix and ver in (first, end):  # e.g. 5.0.0rc1, 5.13.0.dev0: either side of a change
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"olmo3_rope_layout: auto: transformers pre-release {text} is at a layout change; "
+            "set per_type or yarn_all"
+        )
+    return ("yarn_all" if first <= ver < end else "per_type"), text
+
+
+def resolve_olmo3_rope_layout(layout: str = "per_type") -> str:
+    """Per-layer-type RoPE layout.
+
+    * ``"per_type"`` (default): plain RoPE on sliding layers, YaRN on full
+      layers. This is the trained OLMo-3 model (OLMo-core); transformers 4.57
+      measured.
+    * ``"yarn_all"``: one YaRN table (and attention factor) on every layer;
+      transformers 5.10 measured (the version range is unverified, see the

+"""OLMo-3 settings validation, shared by the args patch, ``Olmo3TransformerConfig`` and the builder.
+
+One module, so the three entry points refuse the same settings and read the window the same way.
+
+Window contract
+---------------
+Two conventions exist for the sliding window:
+
+* HF ``sliding_window`` W: keys a query sees, the current token included (4096 for OLMo-3).
+* Megatron / TE ``window_size = (left, right)`` = ``(W - 1, 0)``.
+
+Two settings say which form ``window_size`` holds; neither is ever guessed:
+
+* ``olmo3_window_size_form``: ``hf`` (``window_size = (W, 0)``, the model preset) or ``megatron``
+  (``(W - 1, 0)``). The args patch converts an ``hf`` window once and then sets ``megatron``.
+* ``olmo3_sliding_window = W``: the HF window itself (the converter, the args patch output and
+  saved checkpoint args carry it; the model preset does not set it, so the preset states the window
+  once, as ``window_size: [W, 0]`` with form ``hf``). With it, ``window_size`` must be
+  ``(W - 1, 0)`` (or ``(W, 0)`` when the form says ``hf``), or unset (then it is derived). A
+  ``window_size`` that disagrees is refused, never re-read in the other form.
+
+A ``window_size`` with neither setting is refused: reading it as HF would silently shorten a
+converted window by one key when both settings are lost (they are not argparse options, so
+``use_checkpoint_args`` or a CLI ``null`` can drop them). The converter, the args patch output and
+saved checkpoint args carry both settings. ``Olmo3TransformerConfig`` requires
+``olmo3_sliding_window`` (W); the form decides how ``window_size`` is read.
+
+``window_attn_skip_freq``
+-------------------------
+An int ``k`` with ``2 <= k <= num_layers`` (every k-th layer is full attention), or a 0/1 list of
+``num_layers`` entries (1 = sliding) with at least one 0 and one 1. String forms from the CLI
+(``"4"``, ``"([1]*3+[0])*8"``) are parsed by a small grammar (integers, lists, ``+``, ``*``,
+parentheses), never by ``eval``, with caps on the input and result sizes.
+
+Values may come from the YAML (typed) or from ``--key value`` CLI overrides (strings), so the checks
+accept both.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import math
+
+from primus.core.utils.arg_utils import as_int, is_unset, parse_optional_switch
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OLMO3_UNSUPPORTED",
+    "YARN_BETA_FAST_DEFAULT",
+    "YARN_BETA_SLOW_DEFAULT",
+    "parse_olmo3_skip_freq",
+    "olmo3_window_from_settings",
+    "check_olmo3_unsupported",
+    "check_olmo3_cp",
+    "check_olmo3_norm_epsilon",
+]
+
+# HF's YaRN defaults (transformers ``_compute_yarn_parameters``) for a config that omits them; used
+# by the converter and as the Olmo3TransformerConfig defaults.
+YARN_BETA_FAST_DEFAULT = 32.0
+YARN_BETA_SLOW_DEFAULT = 1.0
+
+
+_MAX_EXPR_CHARS = 4096
+_MAX_LIST_LEN = 65536
+_MAX_INT = 1 << 20
+_MAX_DEPTH = 32
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# value helpers (YAML values or CLI strings)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _as_int(v, what):
+    """The shared ``as_int`` with the OLMo-3 prefix in the message."""
+    return as_int(v, f"OLMo-3 {what}")
+
+
+def _truthy(v):
+    """A switch value: unset (:func:`is_unset`) is False, else the shared ``parse_switch`` (a typo
+    such as "ture" raises ValueError, which check_olmo3_unsupported reports as the setting's error
+    instead of reading it as on or off)."""
+    return parse_optional_switch(v, "switch")
+
+
+def _as_float(v):
+    if isinstance(v, bool):
+        raise ValueError
+    return float(v)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# window_attn_skip_freq: safe parser
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _skip_freq_value(text):
+    """Evaluate a ``window_attn_skip_freq`` string (``"4"``, ``"([1]*3+[0])*8"``, ``"[1,0,]*16"``)
+    without ``eval``: Python's own parser, then only int / list literals (a trailing comma is
+    allowed), unary minus, ``+`` (add ints, join lists) and ``*`` (multiply ints, repeat a list).
+    Floats are refused here as in a list, so every string form has one rule. Sizes are checked
+    before a list is built."""
+
+    def error(why):
+        return ValueError(f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq: cannot parse {text!r} ({why})")
+
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(text.strip(), mode="eval")
+    except (SyntaxError, RecursionError, MemoryError, ValueError) as e:
+        raise error(getattr(e, "msg", None) or type(e).__name__) from None
+
+    def ev(node, depth=0):
+        if depth > _MAX_DEPTH:
+            raise error("nested too deeply")
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and type(node.value) is int:
+            if abs(node.value) > _MAX_INT:
+                raise error("value too large")
+            return node.value
+        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
+            v = ev(node.operand, depth + 1)
+            if isinstance(v, int):
+                return -v
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.List):
+            items = [ev(e, depth + 1) for e in node.elts]
+            if all(isinstance(v, int) for v in items):
+                return items
+            raise error("list entries must be integers")
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.Add, ast.Mult)):
+            a, b = ev(node.left, depth + 1), ev(node.right, depth + 1)
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add) and type(a) is type(b):
+                if isinstance(a, list) and len(a) + len(b) > _MAX_LIST_LEN:
+                    raise error(f"the list would have more than {_MAX_LIST_LEN} entries")
+                return a + b
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult) and not (isinstance(a, list) and isinstance(b, list)):
+                if isinstance(a, int) and isinstance(b, int):
+                    if abs(a * b) > _MAX_INT:
+                        raise error("value too large")
+                    return a * b
+                items, n = (a, b) if isinstance(a, list) else (b, a)
+                if len(items) * max(n, 0) > _MAX_LIST_LEN:
+                    raise error(f"the list would have more than {_MAX_LIST_LEN} entries")
+                return items * n
+            raise error(f"'{'+' if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add) else '*'}' cannot combine these values")
+        raise error(f"only integers, lists, unary -, + and * are allowed, got {ast.unparse(node)!r}")
+
+    return ev(tree.body)
+
+
+def parse_olmo3_skip_freq(skip_freq, num_layers=None):
+    """``window_attn_skip_freq`` as an int ``k`` (``2 <= k <= num_layers``) or a 0/1 list.
+
+    Accepts Megatron's ``--window-attn-skip-freq`` forms: an int, ``"4"``, or a list expression
+    such as ``"([1]*3+[0])*8"`` (parsed without ``eval``). Floats are refused everywhere (``4.0``
+    as in ``[1.0, 0.0]``): Megatron's option is ``type=int`` or a list of ints. A list needs ``num_layers`` entries
+    (when ``num_layers`` is known), at least one sliding layer (1) and one full layer (0).
+    """
+    if is_unset(skip_freq):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "OLMo-3 needs window_attn_skip_freq (4: every 4th layer full attention); without it "
+            "every layer is sliding."
+        )
+    if num_layers is not None:
+        num_layers = _as_int(num_layers, "num_layers")
+    if isinstance(skip_freq, str):
+        if len(skip_freq) > _MAX_EXPR_CHARS:
+            raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq string longer than {_MAX_EXPR_CHARS} characters")
+        skip_freq = _skip_freq_value(skip_freq)
+    if isinstance(skip_freq, int) and not isinstance(skip_freq, bool):
+        if skip_freq < 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq must be >= 2 (1 would make every layer full attention), "
+                f"got {skip_freq}"
+            )
+        if num_layers is not None and skip_freq > num_layers:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq={skip_freq} > num_layers={num_layers}: no layer would be "
+                "full attention"
+            )
+        return skip_freq
+    if isinstance(skip_freq, (list, tuple)):
+        pattern = list(skip_freq)
+        if num_layers is not None and len(pattern) != num_layers:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq list has {len(pattern)} entries for {num_layers} layers"
+            )
+        if any(isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, int) or v not in (0, 1) for v in pattern):
+            raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq list must hold only 0 and 1, got {pattern}")
+        if 1 not in pattern or 0 not in pattern:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq list needs at least one sliding layer (1) and one full "
+                f"attention layer (0), got {pattern}"
+            )
+        return pattern
+    raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 window_attn_skip_freq must be an int or a 0/1 list, got {skip_freq!r}")
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# window_size / olmo3_sliding_window
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _parse_window(ws):
+    if isinstance(ws, str):
+        ws = [v for v in ws.strip().strip("()[]").split(",") if v.strip()]
+    if not isinstance(ws, (list, tuple)):
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 window_size must be a (left, 0) pair, got {ws!r}")
+    ws = tuple(_as_int(v, "window_size entry") for v in ws)
+    if len(ws) != 2 or ws[1] != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 window_size must be (W, 0) (causal, no future keys), got {ws}")
+    return ws
+
+
+_WINDOW_FORMS = ("hf", "megatron")
+
+
+def olmo3_window_from_settings(window_size, sliding_window, form=None):
+    """``(megatron_window, W)`` from ``window_size``, ``olmo3_sliding_window`` (W) and
+    ``olmo3_window_size_form``.
+
+    * ``olmo3_sliding_window`` W set: ``window_size`` must agree with it in its declared form: ``(W - 1, 0)``
+      (``form`` unset or ``megatron``) or ``(W, 0)`` (``form: hf``), or be unset.
+    * W unset: ``form`` says how to read ``window_size``. ``"hf"`` (the model preset):
+      ``(W, 0)``; ``"megatron"``: ``(W - 1, 0)``. In the HF form an odd W is refused: it is how a
+      Megatron/TE value ``(W - 1, 0)`` of an even W looks (``[4095, 0]`` for 4096), and a silent
+      W - 1 would cost one key; an odd W is accepted when ``olmo3_sliding_window`` names it. Without ``form`` the window is ambiguous
+      (a lost W would turn a converted ``(W - 1, 0)`` into ``(W - 2, 0)``) and is refused.
+
+    ``megatron_window`` is ``(W - 1, 0)``.
+    """
+    ws = None if is_unset(window_size) else _parse_window(window_size)
+    form = None if is_unset(form) else str(form).strip().lower()
+    if form is not None and form not in _WINDOW_FORMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 olmo3_window_size_form must be one of {_WINDOW_FORMS}, got {form!r}")
+    if is_unset(sliding_window):
+        if ws is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "OLMo-3 needs window_size: [sliding_window, 0] (HF convention, e.g. [4096, 0]) with "
+                "olmo3_window_size_form: hf; without it every layer runs full attention, which is a "
+                "different model."
+            )
+        if form is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 window_size {ws} without olmo3_sliding_window or olmo3_window_size_form is "
+                "ambiguous (HF (W, 0) or Megatron/TE (W - 1, 0)). Set olmo3_window_size_form: hf for "
+                "the HF form (the model preset does), or olmo3_sliding_window: W for the Megatron form."
+            )
+        if form == "hf" and ws[0] % 2 == 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 window_size {ws} is read in the HF form (olmo3_window_size_form: hf, as the "
+                f"model preset sets), so W = {ws[0]}, an odd window. That is what the Megatron/TE form "
+                f"(W - 1, 0) of W = {ws[0] + 1} looks like, so it is not guessed: for W = {ws[0] + 1} "
+                f"override window_size: [{ws[0] + 1}, 0] (HF form), or set olmo3_window_size_form: "
+                f"megatron; for an odd W = {ws[0]} confirm it with olmo3_sliding_window: {ws[0]}."
+            )

+    else:
+        w = _as_int(sliding_window, "olmo3_sliding_window")

+        if ws is not None and ws[0] not in allowed:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 window_size {ws} disagrees with olmo3_sliding_window={w} "
+                f"(olmo3_window_size_form={form!r}): window_size must be "
+                f"{(w, 0) if form == 'hf' else (w - 1, 0)} in that form. The two come from different "
+                "sources (e.g. an override changed only one of them); the window is not guessed. To "
+                "change the window, set olmo3_sliding_window: W and window_size: null (or both, "
+                "consistently); with the model preset, override window_size: [W, 0]."

+_MISSING = object()
+
+
+def check_olmo3_unsupported(obj):
+    """Raise ``ValueError`` for any :data:`OLMO3_UNSUPPORTED` setting ``obj`` (args or config) has."""
+    for name, ok, why in OLMO3_UNSUPPORTED:
+        value = getattr(obj, name, _MISSING)
+        if value is _MISSING:
+            continue
+        try:
+            good = ok(value)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            good = False
+        if not good:
+            raise ValueError(f"{why} (got {name}={value!r})")
+    check_olmo3_cp(obj)
+    check_olmo3_norm_epsilon(obj)
+
+
+def check_olmo3_norm_epsilon(obj):
+    """The OLMo-3 model reads ``layernorm_epsilon`` (Megatron's dest for ``--norm-epsilon``). A
+    ``norm_epsilon`` that differs from it would be silently ignored, so it is refused."""
+    a, b = getattr(obj, "layernorm_epsilon", None), getattr(obj, "norm_epsilon", None)
+    if is_unset(a) or is_unset(b):
+        return
+    try:
+        same = math.isclose(float(a), float(b), rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=0.0)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        same = False
+    if not same:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"OLMo-3 reads layernorm_epsilon (got {a!r}); norm_epsilon={b!r} differs and would be "
+            "ignored. Set both to the same value (the HF rms_norm_eps)."
+        )
+
+
+def check_olmo3_cp(obj):
+    """TE's sliding-window attention under context parallelism needs cp_comm_type a2a or all_gather."""
+    cp = getattr(obj, "context_parallel_size", 1)
+    cp = 1 if is_unset(cp) else _as_int(cp, "context_parallel_size")
+    cp_comm = getattr(obj, "cp_comm_type", None)
+    cp_comm = "p2p" if is_unset(cp_comm) else cp_comm
+    cp_comm = list(cp_comm) if isinstance(cp_comm, (list, tuple)) else [cp_comm]
+    if cp > 1 and any(c not in ("a2a", "all_gather") for c in cp_comm):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"OLMo-3 sliding-window attention with context_parallel_size={cp} needs "
+            f"cp_comm_type a2a or all_gather, got {cp_comm}"
+        )

+###############################################################################

+#

+###############################################################################
+
+"""OLMo-3 self-attention.
+
+Differences from upstream ``SelfAttention``:
+
+* ``q_norm`` / ``k_norm``: RMSNorm over the full projection width
+  (``num_heads * head_dim``). Under tensor parallelism every rank holds a
+  contiguous slice of the heads, so the weight is TP-sharded along dim 0 and the
+  sum of squares is all-reduced across the TP group. The names deliberately do
+  not contain ``q_layernorm`` / ``k_layernorm``: upstream sums those grads across
+  TP, which is right for replicated per-head norms and wrong for sharded ones.
+  ``FullWidthRMSNorm.sharded_state_dict`` marks the weight TP-sharded on dim 0,
+  so distributed (``torch_dist``) checkpoints save and reshard it across TP sizes.
+  The native HF converter (``native_loader_olmo3``) writes TP=PP=EP=1 legacy ``torch``
+  checkpoints only. Loading converted HF weights at TP > 1 therefore needs a torch -> torch_dist
+  conversion first; that path has not been run for OLMo-3. What is tested at TP = 2: training
+  from scratch, and save / reshard / load of ``torch_dist`` checkpoints Megatron itself wrote.
+* per-layer RoPE: the model hands every layer a stacked ``[2, s, 1, 1, d]``
+  embedding (index 0 = plain RoPE, index 1 = YaRN). Full-attention layers take
+  YaRN; sliding layers take plain RoPE (``olmo3_rope_layout: per_type``) or
+  YaRN (``yarn_all``).
+* per-layer YaRN attention factor: HF multiplies cos and sin by ``m`` on the YaRN
+  layers, which scales q and k by ``m`` and the logits by ``m**2``; it is applied
+  here as ``softmax_scale = m**2 * base_scale`` (``base_scale``: ``config.softmax_scale``
+  if set, else ``1 / sqrt(head_dim)``).
+* per-layer window: HF ``sliding_window`` W (``config.olmo3_sliding_window``) lets a
+  query see keys ``q - W + 1 .. q``, i.e. Megatron / TE ``window_size=(W - 1, 0)``, which
+  is what ``config.window_size`` holds; full-attention layers get no window.
+* ``post_attention_layernorm`` applied to the attention output (post-norm).
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+import math
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes
+from megatron.core.transformer.attention import SelfAttention
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.transformer.utils import (
+    ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group,
+    is_layer_window_attention,
+)
+from megatron.core.utils import get_pg_size, make_tp_sharded_tensor_for_checkpoint
+from torch import Tensor
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_transformer_config import (
+    OLMO3_ROPE_LAYOUTS,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_validation import (
+    olmo3_window_from_settings,
+)
+
+__all__ = [
+    "Olmo3SelfAttention",
+    "FullWidthRMSNorm",
+    "olmo3_layer_is_sliding",
+    "olmo3_te_window",
+]
+
+
+def olmo3_layer_is_sliding(config, layer_number: int) -> bool:
+    """True if the (1-indexed, global) layer uses sliding-window attention."""
+    return bool(is_layer_window_attention(config.window_size, config.window_attn_skip_freq, layer_number))
+
+
+def olmo3_te_window(sliding_window):
+    """HF ``sliding_window`` W -> Megatron / TE ``(W - 1, 0)``; the rule (and the W > 1 check) is
+    :func:`olmo3_window_from_settings`."""
+    return olmo3_window_from_settings(None, sliding_window)[0]
+
+
+class _FullWidthRMSNormFn(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """``(weight * (x * rstd)).to(x.dtype)`` with ``rstd = rsqrt(sum_all_ranks(x**2) / full + eps)``.
+
+    One op for autograd: it saves the input (in its own dtype), the weight and the fp32 ``rstd``
+    (one value per token) and recomputes the rest in backward. An eager chain of fp32 ops would
+    keep about three fp32 copies of the projection (about 6x a bf16 input) per call.
+    Backward: ``dx = rstd * dy - x * rstd**3 * sum_all_ranks(dy * x) / full`` with
+    ``dy = grad * weight``; the row sum spans every TP rank's heads, so it is all-reduced, as the
+    sum of squares is in forward.
+    """
+
+    # x: [..., heads_local, head_dim], used as given (q / k are split views of the fused qkv
+    # output, so a reshape to [..., width] would copy them); weight: [heads_local, head_dim] view.
+    _ROW = (-2, -1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, x, weight, eps, full_width, group):
+        ctype = torch.promote_types(x.dtype, torch.float32)  # fp32 statistics (fp64 stays fp64)
+        h = x.to(ctype)
+        ss = h.pow(2).sum(_FullWidthRMSNormFn._ROW, keepdim=True)
+        if group is not None:
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(ss, group=group)
+        rstd = torch.rsqrt(ss / full_width + eps)
+        ctx.save_for_backward(x, weight, rstd)
+        ctx.full_width, ctx.group = full_width, group
+        return (weight * (h * rstd)).to(x.dtype)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad):
+        x, weight, rstd = ctx.saved_tensors
+        h = x.to(rstd.dtype)
+        g = grad.to(rstd.dtype)
+        y = h * rstd
+        grad_weight = None
+        if ctx.needs_input_grad[1]:
+            grad_weight = (g * y).reshape(-1, *y.shape[-2:]).sum(0).to(weight.dtype)
+        grad_x = None
+        if ctx.needs_input_grad[0]:
+            dy = g * weight.to(rstd.dtype)
+            dot = (dy * h).sum(_FullWidthRMSNormFn._ROW, keepdim=True)
+            if ctx.group is not None:
+                torch.distributed.all_reduce(dot, group=ctx.group)
+            grad_x = (rstd * dy - h * rstd.pow(3) * (dot / ctx.full_width)).to(x.dtype)
+        return grad_x, grad_weight, None, None, None
+
+
+class FullWidthRMSNorm(torch.nn.Module):
+    """RMSNorm over ``[..., heads, head_dim]`` with the heads sharded over TP.
+
+    Matches HF ``Olmo3RMSNorm`` applied to the un-split projection: statistics
+    in fp32, ``(weight * normed).to(input_dtype)``.
+
+    New math: one RMS statistic spans all heads, which are sharded over TP,
+    so the sum of squares is all-reduced across TP. TENorm / RMSNorm / LayerNorm
+    normalise a rank-local last dim only.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        local_width: int,
+        full_width: int,
+        eps: float,
+        config=None,
+        tp_group=None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.local_width = local_width
+        self.full_width = full_width
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.tp_group = tp_group
+        # The group the sum of squares is all-reduced over (None: TP = 1), fixed at build time.
+        self._reduce_group = tp_group if tp_group is not None and get_pg_size(tp_group) > 1 else None
+        dtype = getattr(config, "params_dtype", torch.float32)
+        use_cpu = config is None or getattr(config, "use_cpu_initialization", False)
+        device = "cpu" if use_cpu or not torch.cuda.is_available() else torch.cuda.current_device()
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(local_width, dtype=dtype, device=device))
+        if self._reduce_group is not None:
+            set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(self.weight, True, 0, 1)
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        # x: [s, b, heads_local, head_dim]; normalised in place of its layout (no reshape copy)
+        heads, head_dim = x.shape[-2:]
+        if heads * head_dim != self.local_width:
+            raise ValueError(f"FullWidthRMSNorm: got width {heads * head_dim}, expected {self.local_width}")
+        weight = self.weight.view(heads, head_dim)
+        return _FullWidthRMSNormFn.apply(x, weight, self.eps, self.full_width, self._reduce_group)
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(self, prefix: str = "", sharded_offsets=(), metadata=None):
+        """TP axis map ``{'weight': 0}``: each rank saves its own heads' slice of the weight."""
+        metadata = ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group(metadata)
+        key = f"{prefix}weight"
+        return {
+            key: make_tp_sharded_tensor_for_checkpoint(
+                self.weight,
+                key,
+                tp_axis=0,
+                prepend_offsets=sharded_offsets,
+                tp_group=self.tp_group,
+                dp_cp_group=metadata["dp_cp_group"],
+            )
+        }
+
+    def extra_repr(self):
+        return f"local={self.local_width}, full={self.full_width}, eps={self.eps}"
+
+
+_SCALED_CORE_ATTENTION = {}
+
+
+def _with_softmax_scale(core_attention, softmax_scale):
+    """``core_attention`` (class or ModuleSpec) with ``softmax_scale`` fixed, as a class or a
+    ModuleSpec again: a generated subclass whose ``__init__`` replaces the ``softmax_scale``
+    argument. Not a function: ``build_module`` returns a function unchanged (it would not be
+    called), so the result must stay a class / spec whether upstream calls
+    ``submodules.core_attention(...)`` directly (d3528a2) or through ``build_module``. One class
+    per (class, scale), so layers with the same scale share it."""
+    if isinstance(core_attention, ModuleSpec):
+        return dataclasses.replace(
+            core_attention, module=_with_softmax_scale(core_attention.module, softmax_scale)
+        )
+    if not isinstance(core_attention, type):
+        raise TypeError(
+            f"OLMo-3 YaRN softmax scale: core_attention must be a class or a ModuleSpec of a class, "
+            f"got {core_attention!r}"
+        )
+    key = (core_attention, float(softmax_scale))
+    cls = _SCALED_CORE_ATTENTION.get(key)
+    if cls is None:
+
+        def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            kwargs["softmax_scale"] = softmax_scale
+            core_attention.__init__(self, *args, **kwargs)
+
+        cls = type(
+            core_attention.__name__,
+            (core_attention,),
+            {
+                "__init__": __init__,
+                "__module__": core_attention.__module__,
+                "__qualname__": core_attention.__qualname__,
+                "olmo3_fixed_softmax_scale": float(softmax_scale),
+            },
+        )
+        _SCALED_CORE_ATTENTION[key] = cls
+    return cls
+
+
+class Olmo3SelfAttention(SelfAttention):
+    """Self-attention with OLMo-3's full-width QK-norm, per-layer RoPE/window and post-norm."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, submodules, layer_number: int, *args, post_norm=None, **kwargs):
+        self.olmo3_sliding = olmo3_layer_is_sliding(config, layer_number)
+        # "yarn_all": one YaRN table (and attention factor) on every layer;
+        # "per_type": plain RoPE on sliding layers, YaRN on full layers.
+        layout = config.olmo3_rope_layout
+        if layout not in OLMO3_ROPE_LAYOUTS:
+            # Olmo3TransformerConfig refuses it already; kept so a hand-built config cannot get
+            # an implicit layout.
+            raise ValueError(f"OLMo-3 olmo3_rope_layout must be one of {OLMO3_ROPE_LAYOUTS}, got {layout!r}")
+        self.olmo3_use_yarn = (not self.olmo3_sliding) or layout == "yarn_all"
+        # No private config copy: every layer shares ``config``. Upstream core attention (TE and
+        # local) already applies ``config.window_size`` = (W - 1, 0) per layer through
+        # is_layer_window_attention(window_size, window_attn_skip_freq, layer_number), the same
+        # rule as olmo3_layer_is_sliding, so full-attention layers get no window.
+        if self.olmo3_sliding:
+            expected = olmo3_te_window(config.olmo3_sliding_window)
+            if tuple(config.window_size) != expected:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"OLMo-3 window_size {tuple(config.window_size)} != {expected} "
+                    f"(olmo3_sliding_window - 1, 0 with olmo3_sliding_window={config.olmo3_sliding_window})"
+                )
+        # The upstream default (Attention sets hidden_size_per_attention_head = kv_channels), once.
+        base_scale = (
+            config.softmax_scale if config.softmax_scale is not None else 1.0 / math.sqrt(config.kv_channels)
+        )
+        self.olmo3_softmax_scale = None
+        if self.olmo3_use_yarn:
+            mscale = config.olmo3_yarn_mscale
+            if mscale != 1.0:
+                self.olmo3_softmax_scale = base_scale * mscale * mscale
+                # The per-layer scale goes to this layer's core attention only (upstream passes
+                # config.softmax_scale); the shared config is not changed.
+                submodules = dataclasses.replace(
+                    submodules,
+                    core_attention=_with_softmax_scale(submodules.core_attention, self.olmo3_softmax_scale),
+                )
+        super().__init__(config, submodules, layer_number, *args, **kwargs)
+        # The scale this layer's core attention uses. Upstream's dynamic-batching kernel
+        # (Attention.flash_decode_and_prefill) reads self.softmax_scale and else falls back to
+        # head_dim ** -0.5, which would drop the YaRN m**2; forward() refuses that path anyway
+        # (it also applies no sliding window), and this keeps the attribute right for any reader.
+        self.softmax_scale = self.olmo3_softmax_scale if self.olmo3_softmax_scale is not None else base_scale
+        eps = config.layernorm_epsilon
+        hd = self.hidden_size_per_attention_head
+        self.q_norm = FullWidthRMSNorm(
+            self.num_attention_heads_per_partition * hd,
+            config.num_attention_heads * hd,
+            eps,
+            config=config,
+            tp_group=self.tp_group,
+        )
+        self.k_norm = FullWidthRMSNorm(
+            self.num_query_groups_per_partition * hd,
+            config.num_query_groups * hd,
+            eps,
+            config=config,
+            tp_group=self.tp_group,
+        )
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = (
+            post_norm(config=config, hidden_size=config.hidden_size, eps=eps)
+            if post_norm is not None
+            else None
+        )
+
+    def get_query_key_value_tensors(
+        self, hidden_states, key_value_states=None, output_gate=False, split_qkv=True
+    ):
+        if not split_qkv or output_gate:
+            # Olmo3TransformerConfig refuses fused_single_qkv_rope / attention_output_gate, the
+            # settings that make upstream request these; kept as a guard that survives -O.
+            raise ValueError("OLMo-3 attention needs split q/k/v and no output gate")
+        query, key, value = super().get_query_key_value_tensors(
+            hidden_states, key_value_states, output_gate=False, split_qkv=True
+        )
+        return self.q_norm(query), self.k_norm(key), value
+
+    def _select_rotary(self, rotary_pos_emb):
+        """Pick this layer's table from the stacked ``[2, s, 1, 1, d]`` (plain, YaRN) tensor
+        of ``Olmo3DualRotaryEmbedding``. Any other form would put one table on every layer
+        and lose the sliding / full distinction, so it raises."""
+        if rotary_pos_emb is None:
+            return None
+        if not torch.is_tensor(rotary_pos_emb) or rotary_pos_emb.dim() != 5 or rotary_pos_emb.shape[0] != 2:
+            got = (
+                tuple(rotary_pos_emb.shape)
+                if torch.is_tensor(rotary_pos_emb)
+                else type(rotary_pos_emb).__name__
+            )
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"OLMo-3 attention needs the stacked [2, ...] RoPE table of Olmo3DualRotaryEmbedding, got {got}"
+            )
+        return rotary_pos_emb[1 if self.olmo3_use_yarn else 0]
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, attention_mask, *args, rotary_pos_emb=None, **kwargs):
+        # positional order upstream: key_value_states, inference_context, ...
+        ctx = kwargs.get("inference_context", kwargs.get("inference_params"))
+        if ctx is None and len(args) > 1:
+            ctx = args[1]
+        if ctx is not None and not ctx.is_static_batching():
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "OLMo-3 attention does not support dynamic-batching inference: upstream's "
+                "flash_decode_and_prefill applies no sliding window and no per-layer YaRN scale"
+            )
+        out, bias = super().forward(
+            hidden_states,
+            attention_mask,
+            *args,
+            rotary_pos_emb=self._select_rotary(rotary_pos_emb),
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        if self.post_attention_layernorm is not None:
+            if bias is not None:
+                out = out + bias
+                bias = None
+            out = self.post_attention_layernorm(out)
+        return out, bias

+"""OLMo-3 MLP: SwiGLU MLP followed by ``post_feedforward_layernorm`` (post-norm)."""
+
+from megatron.core.transformer.mlp import MLP, apply_swiglu_sharded_factory
+from megatron.core.transformer.utils import sharded_state_dict_default
+
+__all__ = ["Olmo3MLP"]
+

+class Olmo3MLP(MLP):

+        super().__init__(config, submodules, *args, **kwargs)

+
+"""OLMo-3 (``model_type: olmo3``) argument patches.
+
+``megatron.olmo3.args`` (phase ``before_train``):
+
+* Window. The rules live in
+  :mod:`primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_validation` (one contract for the args
+  patch, ``Olmo3TransformerConfig`` and the builder). ``olmo3_window_size_form`` says which form
+  ``window_size`` holds (``hf``: ``[W, 0]``, the model preset; ``megatron``: ``(W - 1, 0)``), so it
+  decides whether the window is already converted; ``olmo3_sliding_window`` is the HF window W the
+  converted value must agree with. This patch converts an HF window
+  once to Megatron / TE ``(W - 1, 0)`` and sets ``olmo3_sliding_window = W`` and
+  ``olmo3_window_size_form = megatron``. A window with neither setting is ambiguous and raises
+  (never guessed, so a lost form or W cannot shorten the window by one key). The patch is
+  idempotent.
+* ``window_attn_skip_freq`` is required: an int ``2 <= k <= num_layers`` or a 0/1 list of
+  ``num_layers`` entries with at least one 0 and one 1; CLI strings (``"4"``,
+  ``"([1]*3+[0])*8"``) are parsed without ``eval``.
+* Settings the OLMo-3 model does not implement are refused with the shared
+  :data:`OLMO3_UNSUPPORTED` table (the same table the config and the builder use).
+"""
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_validation import (
+    check_olmo3_unsupported,
+    olmo3_window_from_settings,
+    parse_olmo3_skip_freq,
+)
+from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, get_args, register_patch
+from primus.core.utils.module_utils import log_rank_0
+
+__all__ = ["is_olmo3_model_type", "patch_olmo3_args"]
+
+
+def is_olmo3_model_type(ctx: PatchContext) -> bool:
+    """Patch condition shared by the OLMo-3 patches: ``model_type`` is ``olmo3``."""
+    return getattr(get_args(ctx), "model_type", None) == "olmo3"
+
+
+@register_patch(
+    "megatron.olmo3.args",
+    backend="megatron",
+    phase="before_train",
+    description="OLMo-3: HF (W, 0) window -> Megatron (W-1, 0) + olmo3_sliding_window; refuse unsupported settings.",
+    condition=is_olmo3_model_type,
+)
+def patch_olmo3_args(ctx: PatchContext):
+    args = get_args(ctx)
+    ws, w = olmo3_window_from_settings(
+        getattr(args, "window_size", None),
+        getattr(args, "olmo3_sliding_window", None),
+        getattr(args, "olmo3_window_size_form", None),
+    )
+    skip = parse_olmo3_skip_freq(
+        getattr(args, "window_attn_skip_freq", None), getattr(args, "num_layers", None)
+    )
+    check_olmo3_unsupported(args)
+    before = getattr(args, "window_size", None)
+    converted = before is None or isinstance(before, str) or tuple(int(x) for x in before) != tuple(ws)
+    args.window_size = ws
+    args.olmo3_sliding_window = w
+    args.olmo3_window_size_form = "megatron"
+    args.window_attn_skip_freq = skip

+            f"[Patch:megatron.olmo3.args] sliding_window={w}: window_size {before!r} -> {ws} (Megatron/TE) "
+            f"window_attn_skip_freq={skip}"
+        )
+    else:
+        log_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:megatron.olmo3.args] window_size={ws} (already Megatron form, sliding_window={w}) "
+            f"window_attn_skip_freq={skip}"
+        )

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""OLMo-3 FLOPs: correct the core-attention term for sliding-window layers.
+
+Megatron's ``num_floating_point_operations`` counts causal attention over the
+full sequence (``seq_length / 2`` keys per query on average) on every layer.
+OLMo-3's sliding layers (3 of 4) let a query see at most ``W`` keys
+(``olmo3_sliding_window``, HF ``sliding_window`` convention, current token included;
+Megatron's ``window_size`` is ``(W - 1, 0)``).
+This patch subtracts, per sliding layer, the difference between the causal
+count and the windowed count; every other term (projections, MLP, logits) is
+the upstream one.
+
+Convention: upstream's. Upstream counts causal attention as ``s / 2`` keys per query, the
+continuous form of ``sum_i (i + 1) / s = (s + 1) / 2``. The same continuous form of the windowed
+count ``sum_i min(i + 1, W) / s`` is ``W - W**2 / (2 s)`` for ``W < s`` (``s / 2`` for
+``W >= s``). The correction is the difference of the two, ``(s - W)**2 / (2 s)`` keys per query
+for ``W < s``; for ``W >= s`` the window does not cut anything and the correction is 0 (an explicit
+branch in :func:`olmo3_saved_keys`). A sliding layer then counts
+``W - W**2 / (2 s)`` keys, which is within half a key of the exact windowed mean, as upstream's
+``s / 2`` is within half a key of the exact causal mean. :func:`olmo3_mean_visible_keys` gives
+the exact mean, for reference and tests.
+
+Upstream must not count the window itself, or it would be subtracted twice, and it must count
+causal attention as ``s / 2`` keys per query, the count the correction subtracts from. The patch
+checks both when it installs (and, without built args or before the tokenizer sets
+``padded_vocab_size``, at the first call): upstream's count for the run's args must not change
+when ``window_size`` / ``window_attn_skip_freq`` are removed (:func:`upstream_counts_window`), and
+its ``seq_length**2`` coefficient must be the core-attention term of ``s / 2`` keys per query
+(:func:`upstream_causal_keys_ok`). If either check fails (a newer Megatron counts windows, or
+counts attention another way), the correction is not applied and a warning says so.
+
+Where the count goes (Megatron at the pinned commit): the throughput log, and the running total
+``num_floating_point_operations_so_far`` (training.py, added per iteration), which the progress log
+prints and ``save_checkpoint`` stores in the checkpoint; a resumed run continues from the stored
+total. So the corrected count is persisted. A run resumed without this patch (or with a Megatron
+that counts windows itself) continues the stored total with another count per iteration; the
+total then mixes the two counts. The total is reporting only: no schedule, stop rule or optimizer
+step reads it, so neither the patch nor the wrapper stops training. An error at install time (in
+the upstream check, or in a first try of the correction) is only logged and retried at the first
+count; an error at the first count, or in the correction itself, turns the
+correction off with a warning (from then on, the count added to the total is upstream's; the
+warning names the switch, so a mixed total can be found in the log).
+
+The wrapper stays installed for the rest of the process (Megatron keeps no handle to undo it). It
+corrects only the args of an OLMo-3 run: ``olmo3_window_size_form`` is set by the OLMo-3 args patch
+alone, so a later non-OLMo-3 run in the same process gets upstream's count. A second OLMo-3 install
+in the same process keeps the installed wrapper (around the upstream function it wrapped first)
+and resets its per-run state; the new run is then checked at install time, as a first install
+does.
+"""
+
+import copy
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.models.olmo3.olmo3_validation import (
+    olmo3_window_from_settings,
+    parse_olmo3_skip_freq,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches.olmo3_args_patches import is_olmo3_model_type
+from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, register_patch
+from primus.core.utils.module_utils import log_rank_0, warning_rank_0
+
+__all__ = [
+    "olmo3_sliding_layer_count",
+    "olmo3_mean_visible_keys",
+    "olmo3_saved_keys",
+    "olmo3_attention_flops_correction",
+    "upstream_counts_window",
+]
+
+
+def olmo3_sliding_layer_count(num_layers, megatron_window, skip_freq) -> int:
+    """Sliding layers: the layers upstream core attention gives ``megatron_window`` (TE / local
+    ``is_layer_window_attention``, 1-indexed, the rule ``olmo3_layer_is_sliding`` uses).
+
+    ``skip_freq`` is parsed and checked by :func:`parse_olmo3_skip_freq` (the args patch rules):
+    an int ``2 <= k <= num_layers``, a 0/1 list of ``num_layers`` entries, or their string forms.
+    """
+    # Imported here: patch modules are imported before Megatron is on sys.path.
+    from megatron.core.transformer.utils import is_layer_window_attention
+
+    num_layers = int(num_layers)
+    skip = parse_olmo3_skip_freq(skip_freq, num_layers)
+    window = None if megatron_window is None else tuple(megatron_window)
+    return sum(1 for n in range(1, num_layers + 1) if is_layer_window_attention(window, skip, n))
+
+
+def _window_keys(window) -> int:
+    """HF W (keys incl. the current token); the same W > 1 rule as the args patch."""
+    return olmo3_window_from_settings(None, window)[1]
+
+
+def olmo3_mean_visible_keys(seq_len: int, window: int) -> float:
+    """Mean keys per query under a causal window of ``window`` keys (HF W, current token included)."""
+    s, w = int(seq_len), _window_keys(window)
+    if w >= s:
+        return (s + 1) / 2.0
+    # i + 1 for i < w, then w
+    return (w * (w + 1) / 2.0 + (s - w) * w) / s
+
+
+def olmo3_saved_keys(seq_len: int, window: int) -> float:
+    """Keys per query a causal window of ``window`` keys skips, in upstream's continuous
+    convention: ``s / 2 - (W - W**2 / (2 s)) = (s - W)**2 / (2 s)`` for ``W < s``, else 0."""
+    s, w = int(seq_len), _window_keys(window)
+    if w >= s:
+        return 0.0
+    return (s - w) ** 2 / (2.0 * s)
+
+
+def _hashable(v):
+    return tuple(_hashable(x) for x in v) if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) else v
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=8)
+def _correction_per_sample(
+    window_size, sliding_window, form, skip_freq, num_layers, seq_length, kv_channels, num_attention_heads
+) -> float:
+    # The window as the args patch reads it (same function, same forms): (W - 1, 0) and W.
+    megatron_window, w = olmo3_window_from_settings(window_size, sliding_window, form)
+    n_sliding = olmo3_sliding_layer_count(num_layers, megatron_window, skip_freq)
+    s = int(seq_length)
+    q_size = int(kv_channels) * int(num_attention_heads)
+    # 3 (fwd + bwd) * 2 (FMA) * q_size * keys * 2 (QK^T and PV), per token
+    per_token = 3 * 2 * q_size * olmo3_saved_keys(s, w) * 2
+    return float(s * per_token * n_sliding)
+
+
+def olmo3_attention_flops_correction(args, batch_size) -> float:
+    """FLOPs to subtract from upstream's count (>= 0): attention work the window skips.
+
+    Per sliding layer, upstream's causal ``s / 2`` keys per query minus the windowed count in
+    the same (continuous) convention; see the module docstring. The window is read with
+    ``olmo3_window_from_settings`` (the args patch's reader, any declared form); the per-sample
+    value is computed once per setting and scaled by ``batch_size``.
+    """
+    per_sample = _correction_per_sample(
+        _hashable(getattr(args, "window_size", None)),
+        getattr(args, "olmo3_sliding_window", None),
+        getattr(args, "olmo3_window_size_form", None),
+        _hashable(getattr(args, "window_attn_skip_freq", None)),
+        args.num_layers,
+        args.seq_length,
+        args.kv_channels,
+        args.num_attention_heads,
+    )
+    return float(batch_size) * per_sample
+
+
+def upstream_counts_window(original_fn, args) -> bool:
+    """True if upstream's ``num_floating_point_operations`` already depends on the attention
+    window: its count for ``args`` changes when ``window_size`` and ``window_attn_skip_freq`` are
+    removed. Runs on copies (upstream writes to ``args``, e.g. ``num_query_groups``)."""
+    with_window, without = copy.copy(args), copy.copy(args)
+    without.window_size, without.window_attn_skip_freq = None, None
+    return original_fn(with_window, 1) != original_fn(without, 1)
+
+
+def upstream_causal_keys_ok(original_fn, args) -> bool:
+    """True if upstream counts core attention as ``seq_length / 2`` keys per query, the convention
+    :func:`olmo3_saved_keys` subtracts from. Upstream's count without the window is
+    ``c + a * s + b * s**2`` in the sequence length ``s`` (the second difference below cancels
+    ``c`` and ``a``); only core attention gives the ``s**2`` term, so ``b`` must be ``3 (fwd + bwd) * 2 (FMA) * q_size * 1 / 2 (keys per query and token) * 2
+    (QK^T and PV)`` per layer, ``q_size = kv_channels * num_attention_heads``. Runs on copies."""
+
+    def count(s):
+        a = copy.copy(args)
+        a.window_size, a.window_attn_skip_freq, a.seq_length = None, None, s
+        return float(original_fn(a, 1))
+
+    s = 1024
+    b = (count(3 * s) - 2 * count(2 * s) + count(s)) / (2.0 * s * s)
+    layers = int(args.num_layers) + int(getattr(args, "mtp_num_layers", None) or 0)
+    want = 6.0 * int(args.kv_channels) * int(args.num_attention_heads) * layers
+    return abs(b - want) <= 1e-6 * want
+
+
+def _check_at_install(check_upstream, run_args):
+    """Run the upstream check at install time when the built args allow it. Upstream's count reads
+    ``padded_vocab_size``, which the tokenizer sets after this phase: without it the check waits
+    for the first count."""
+    if run_args is not None and getattr(run_args, "padded_vocab_size", None) is not None:
+        check_upstream(run_args, final=False)
+
+
+def _installed_wrapper(fn):
+    """The OLMo-3 wrapper if ``fn`` or any function it wraps (``__wrapped__`` chain) is it, else None."""
+    seen = set()
+    while fn is not None and id(fn) not in seen:
+        if getattr(fn, "_olmo3_flops_patched", False):
+            return fn
+        seen.add(id(fn))
+        fn = getattr(fn, "__wrapped__", None)
+    return None
+
+
+@register_patch(
+    "megatron.olmo3.flops",
+    backend="megatron",
+    phase="before_train",
+    description="OLMo-3: count windowed (not full causal) attention on sliding-window layers.",
+    condition=is_olmo3_model_type,
+)
+def patch_olmo3_flops(ctx: PatchContext):
+    import megatron.training.training as training_module
+
+    # Try the correction once now so a problem shows in the log at patch time (also on a second
+    # install in the same process). The FLOPs count is reporting only (the throughput log and the
+    # running total num_floating_point_operations_so_far that the checkpoint stores; see the module
+    # docstring), so a failure here never stops the run: the window / skip settings are validated
+    # by megatron.olmo3.args, and a correction that still fails at the first count turns itself off
+    # with a warning.
+    run_args = (getattr(ctx, "extra", None) or {}).get("backend_args")  # Megatron's built args
+    if run_args is not None and getattr(run_args, "num_layers", None) is not None:
+        try:
+            olmo3_attention_flops_correction(run_args, 1)
+        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - reporting only; must not stop training
+            warning_rank_0(
+                f"[Patch:megatron.olmo3.flops] cannot compute the correction at install time "
+                f"({type(e).__name__}: {e}); retried at the first FLOPs count"
+            )
+
+    installed = _installed_wrapper(training_module.num_floating_point_operations)
+    if installed is not None:
+        # a second install in the same process (a new run): keep the one wrapper (it still wraps
+        # the same upstream function: anything installed since then wraps it in turn), reset its
+        # per-run state, and check this run now, as a first install does
+        installed._olmo3_state.update(checked=False, apply=True)
+        _check_at_install(installed._olmo3_check_upstream, run_args)
+        return
+    original_fn = training_module.num_floating_point_operations
+
+    state = {"checked": False, "apply": True}
+
+    def disable(why):
+        state["checked"], state["apply"] = True, False
+        warning_rank_0(
+            f"[Patch:megatron.olmo3.flops] {why}; the OLMo-3 sliding-window correction is not applied"
+        )
+
+    def check_upstream(args, final=True):
+        # Once per run: the correction is applied only to an upstream count that does not depend on
+        # the window and counts causal attention as s / 2 keys per query (the convention the
+        # correction subtracts from). The count is reporting only, so a check never stops training.
+        # At install time (final=False) the args may be incomplete: a failure there is logged and
+        # the check is retried at the first count. A failure at the first count turns the
+        # correction off (the count stays upstream's, never corrected unchecked).
+        if not state["checked"]:
+            try:
+                counts_window = upstream_counts_window(original_fn, args)
+                keys = upstream_causal_keys_ok(original_fn, args)
